module

public import HadamardMultibase.LogMeshAsymptotics
public import HadamardMultibase.LogarithmicApproximation

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

theorem logarithmicApproximation_of_separation {S : Set ℕ} {p q : ℕ}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hmem : ∀ l m : ℕ, p ^ l * q ^ m ∈ S)
    (hsep : PolynomialRotationSeparation (Real.log (q : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ))) :
    LogarithmicApproximation S := by
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < p by omega)
  have hqR : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < q by omega)
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by linarith
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hlogp : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hpR
  have hlogq : 0 < Real.log (q : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hqR
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hmesh⟩ := eventual_nonnegative_log_mesh (div_pos hlogq hlogp) hsep
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (n : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).atTop_div_const hlogp
  refine ⟨Real.log (p : ℝ) * (Real.log (p : ℝ)) ^ κ, κ, by positivity, hκ, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually hmesh, eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)] with n hn hn₂
  obtain ⟨l, m, hl, hu⟩ := hn
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega)
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hlogn : 0 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hnR
  let b : ℕ := p ^ l * q ^ m
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hlogb : Real.log (b : ℝ) =
      ((l : ℝ) + (m : ℝ) * (Real.log (q : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ))) * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [b]
    push_cast
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
    field_simp
  have hupper : Real.log (b : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [hlogb]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hlogp.le
    simpa only [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlogp.ne'] using h
  have hbn : b ≤ n := by
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hupper
    rw [Real.exp_log hbR, Real.exp_log hn0] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  refine ⟨b, hmem l m, hb, hbn, ?_⟩
  have hlower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl hlogp.le
  have herror : 1 / (Real.log (n : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ)) ^ κ * Real.log (p : ℝ) =
      Real.log (p : ℝ) * (Real.log (p : ℝ)) ^ κ / (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ κ := by
    rw [Real.div_rpow hlogn.le hlogp.le]
    field_simp
  rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlogp.ne', herror, ← hlogb] at hlower
  exact hlower

theorem sparse_bound_of_separation {S : Set ℕ} {p q : ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ S, 0 < a)
    (hrep : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ s : Finset ℕ, DistinctSum S n s)
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hmem : ∀ l m : ℕ, p ^ l * q ^ m ∈ S)
    (hsep : PolynomialRotationSeparation (Real.log (q : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ))) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2 < n →
      ∃ s : Finset ℕ, DistinctSum S n s ∧ (s.card : ℝ) ≤ K * logScale n :=
  sparse_bound_of_approximation hpos hrep
    (logarithmicApproximation_of_separation hp hq hmem hsep).polynomialRemainder

theorem binary_sparse_bound_of_separation {S : Set ℕ} {q : ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ S, 0 < a) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hmem : ∀ l m : ℕ, 2 ^ l * q ^ m ∈ S)
    (hsep : PolynomialRotationSeparation (Real.log (q : ℝ) / Real.log 2)) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2 < n →
      ∃ s : Finset ℕ, DistinctSum S n s ∧ (s.card : ℝ) ≤ K * logScale n := by
  apply sparse_bound_of_separation hpos (p := 2) (q := q)
    (exists_distinctSum_of_powers_two (fun a => by simpa using hmem a 0))
    (by norm_num) hq hmem hsep

theorem sparseRepresentationBound_of_separation
    (hsep : PolynomialRotationSeparation (Real.log 10 / Real.log 2)) :
    SparseRepresentationBound := by
  apply sparseRepresentationBound_of_logarithmicApproximation
  exact logarithmicApproximation_of_separation (p := 2) (q := 10)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (fun l m => ⟨l, m, rfl⟩) hsep

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.Basic
public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Padics.PadicVal.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.BitIndices

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

private instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨by decide⟩
private instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
private instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 13) := ⟨by decide⟩

@[simp] private theorem val₂₂ : padicValRat 2 2 = 1 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 2) (n := 2)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₂₁₀ : padicValRat 2 10 = 1 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 2) (n := 10)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₂₂₆ : padicValRat 2 26 = 1 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 2) (n := 26)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₅₂ : padicValRat 5 2 = 0 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 5) (n := 2)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₅₁₀ : padicValRat 5 10 = 1 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 5) (n := 10)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₅₂₆ : padicValRat 5 26 = 0 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 5) (n := 26)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₁₃₂ : padicValRat 13 2 = 0 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 13) (n := 2)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₁₃₁₀ : padicValRat 13 10 = 0 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 13) (n := 10)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])
@[simp] private theorem val₁₃₂₆ : padicValRat 13 26 = 1 :=
  (padicValRat.of_nat (p := 13) (n := 26)).trans (by norm_num [padicValNat, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv, Nat.maxPowDvdDiv.go])

private theorem val_smooth (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a b c : ℤ) :
    padicValRat p ((2 : ℚ) ^ a * 10 ^ b * 26 ^ c) =
      a * padicValRat p 2 + b * padicValRat p 10 + c * padicValRat p 26 := by
  rw [padicValRat.mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
    padicValRat.mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  simp

/-- Full multiplicative independence, allowing arbitrary integer exponents. -/
theorem independent_two_ten_twentySix (a b c : ℤ)
    (h : (2 : ℚ) ^ a * 10 ^ b * 26 ^ c = 1) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 := by
  have h₂ := congrArg (padicValRat 2) h
  have h₅ := congrArg (padicValRat 5) h
  have h₁₃ := congrArg (padicValRat 13) h
  simp only [val_smooth, val₂₂, val₂₁₀, val₂₂₆, val₅₂, val₅₁₀, val₅₂₆,
    val₁₃₂, val₁₃₁₀, val₁₃₂₆, padicValRat.one, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero,
    zero_add] at h₂ h₅ h₁₃
  exact ⟨by omega, h₅, h₁₃⟩

theorem independent_two_ten (a b : ℤ) (h : (2 : ℚ) ^ a * 10 ^ b = 1) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
  have h' := independent_two_ten_twentySix a b 0 (by simpa using h)
  exact ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1⟩

/-- This finite encoding will also be used to count elements of the monoid. -/
theorem powerProducts₃_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun e : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => 2 ^ e.1 * 10 ^ e.2.1 * 26 ^ e.2.2) := by
  rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩ ⟨a', b', c'⟩ h
  have hq : (2 : ℚ) ^ (a : ℤ) * 10 ^ (b : ℤ) * 26 ^ (c : ℤ) =
      2 ^ (a' : ℤ) * 10 ^ (b' : ℤ) * 26 ^ (c' : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  have h₂ := congrArg (padicValRat 2) hq
  have h₅ := congrArg (padicValRat 5) hq
  have h₁₃ := congrArg (padicValRat 13) hq
  simp only [val_smooth, val₂₂, val₂₁₀, val₂₂₆, val₅₂, val₅₁₀, val₅₂₆,
    val₁₃₂, val₁₃₁₀, val₁₃₂₆, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] at h₂ h₅ h₁₃
  have ha : a = a' := by omega
  have hb : b = b' := by omega
  have hc : c = c' := by omega
  simp [ha, hb, hc]

theorem powerProducts₂_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => 2 ^ e.1 * 10 ^ e.2) := by
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨a', b'⟩ h
  have h' := powerProducts₃_injective (a₁ := (a, b, 0)) (a₂ := (a', b', 0))
    (by simpa using h)
  simpa using h'

/-- Every natural number has a distinct-summand multi-base representation,
using just the powers of two. This proves KSW's representability hypothesis. -/
theorem exists_sparseDecomposition (n : ℕ) : ∃ s : Finset ℕ, SparseDecomposition n s := by
  let s := n.bitIndices.toFinset.image (fun i => 2 ^ i)
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact ⟨a, 0, by simp⟩
  · dsimp [s]
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · simpa using (List.sum_toFinset (fun i => 2 ^ i) Nat.bitIndices_nodup).trans
        (Nat.sum_map_two_pow_bitIndices n)
    · intro a _ b _ h
      exact Nat.pow_right_injective (by omega) h

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.Transfer
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Monotone
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.InvLog

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

/-- The real-variable version of the scale used in the manuscript. -/
noncomputable def logScaleReal (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log x / Real.log (Real.log x)

theorem logScaleReal_natCast (n : ℕ) : logScaleReal n = logScale n := rfl

theorem logScaleReal_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x) :
    0 < logScaleReal x := by
  have he : 1 < Real.exp 1 := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  exact div_pos (by linarith) (Real.log_pos (by linarith))

theorem one_le_logScaleReal {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x) :
    1 ≤ logScaleReal x := by
  have he : 1 < Real.exp 1 := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hl : 0 < Real.log (Real.log x) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hl).mpr
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < Real.log x by linarith)
  linarith

/-- Eventual monotonicity with an explicit real threshold. -/
theorem logScaleReal_mono {x y : ℝ} (hxpos : 0 < x)
    (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    logScaleReal x ≤ logScaleReal y := by
  have hlog : Real.log x ≤ Real.log y := Real.log_le_log hxpos hxy
  have hy := hx.trans hlog
  have he : 1 < Real.exp 1 := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hx₀ : 0 < Real.log x := by linarith
  have hy₀ : 0 < Real.log y := by linarith
  have hxx : 0 < Real.log (Real.log x) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hyy : 0 < Real.log (Real.log y) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have h := Real.log_div_self_antitoneOn hx hy hlog
  have h' := (div_le_div_iff₀ hy₀ hx₀).mp h
  exact (div_le_div_iff₀ hxx hyy).mpr (by nlinarith)

theorem eventually_logScale_threshold :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) :=
  (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop _

/-- The scale is sublogarithmic; this analytic fact has no construction inputs. -/
theorem tendsto_logScale_div_log :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => logScale n / Real.log n) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (Real.log n)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp
      (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  apply ht.inv_tendsto_atTop.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_logScale_threshold] with n hn
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le hn
  dsimp [logScale]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hpos]

/-- The main exponent estimate from construction and representation inputs.
All change-of-variable and constant-absorption
steps from the manuscript are discharged here. -/
theorem main_bound_of_inputs (hG : GolayFamily) (hC : CraigenTransfer)
    (hS : SparseRepresentationBound) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, N ≤ p → Odd p →
      ∃ t : ℕ, HadamardOrder (2 ^ t * p) ∧ (t : ℝ) ≤ C * logScale p := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := exponent_bound_of_inputs hG hC hS
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp eventually_logScale_threshold
  let N := max N₀ 3
  refine ⟨2 * K + 2, by positivity, 2 * N + 1, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hpodd
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hpodd.exists_bit1
  have hq : N ≤ q := by omega
  have hq₃ : 2 < q := by dsimp [N] at hq; omega
  have hqlog := hN₀ q (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hq)
  have hqp : (q : ℝ) ≤ (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show q ≤ 2 * q + 1 by omega)
  have hpScale : 1 ≤ logScale (2 * q + 1) :=
    one_le_logScaleReal (hqlog.trans (Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hqp))
  have hscale : logScale q ≤ logScale (2 * q + 1) :=
    logScaleReal_mono (by positivity) hqlog hqp
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htb⟩ := hbound q hq₃
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  nlinarith

theorem tau_bound_of_inputs (hG : GolayFamily) (hC : CraigenTransfer)
    (hS : SparseRepresentationBound) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, N ≤ p → Odd p →
      ∀ h : HasExponent p, (tau p h : ℝ) ≤ C * logScale p := by
  obtain ⟨C, hCpos, N, h⟩ := main_bound_of_inputs hG hC hS
  refine ⟨C, hCpos, N, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hodd hex
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htb⟩ := h p hp hodd
  exact (show (tau p hex : ℝ) ≤ t by exact_mod_cast tau_le hex ht).trans htb

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerUniformPerturbation
public import HadamardMultibase.BakerGridStep
public import HadamardMultibase.BakerUniformGrowth

@[expose] public section

/-! # Exact arithmetic propagation of the vanishing grid -/
namespace HadamardMultibase
open Filter

theorem bakerIndexedMixed_comparison_cast (h L u v l : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (q a b : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ) :
    ‖bakerIndexedMixed h L u v ((p : ℝ) / q) a c l -
      (((bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c : ℚ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ =
      |bakerMixedRealValue h u v ((p : ℝ) / q) a c
          (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L) l -
        ∑ j, (c j : ℝ) * ((bakerComparisonValue h (bakerColumnDegree h L j) u v l
          (bakerColumnLam h L j) (bakerColumnMu h L j) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| := by
  unfold bakerIndexedMixed
  rw [show (l : ℂ) = ((l : ℝ) : ℂ) by simp, bakerMixedComplex_eval_real, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
    Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  simp only [bakerIndexedComparison, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_intCast]

theorem three_exp_margin {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (D : ℝ) :
    3 * Real.exp ((-D - 2) * h) < Real.exp (-D * h) := by
  have he : (3 : ℝ) < Real.exp 2 := by
    have hx := Real.add_one_lt_exp (show (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hhR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have he' : (3 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * (h : ℝ)) :=
    he.trans_le (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  calc
    _ < Real.exp (2 * (h : ℝ)) * Real.exp ((-D - 2) * h) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right he' (Real.exp_pos _)
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

noncomputable def bakerMixedCircleRate (L w a : ℕ) (Γ C : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  C + 2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 + 1 +
    (((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 + Γ * |Real.log a|) * w

noncomputable def bakerComparisonZeroRate (K : ℕ) : ℝ := (Real.log 4 + 5) * K

theorem eventually_baker_comparison_grid_step {L S K k s t w a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (htw : t < w) (htS : t ≤ S) (hbudget : 4 * k ≤ K)
    {Γ : ℝ} (hΓ : 1 ≤ Γ) (C A : ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hdata : C + bakerGridEntryRate L S a b + 1 - A + 2 +
      4 * (k : ℝ) * ((t : ℝ) + s) ≤ -bakerComparisonZeroRate K - 2)
    (hcontour : bakerMixedCircleRate L w a Γ C + ((2 * k * s : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      Real.log (((t : ℝ) + s) / ((w : ℝ) - t)) + 1 ≤ -bakerComparisonZeroRate K - 2) :
    ∀ᶠ h : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p : ℤ, ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp h →
      ∀ c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ,
      (∀ j, |(c j : ℝ)| ≤ Real.exp (C * h)) →
      (∀ j, |(bakerColumnLam h L j : ℝ) + (bakerColumnMu h L j : ℝ) * p / q| ≤ Γ) →
      |((p : ℝ) / q) * Real.log a - Real.log b| ≤ Real.exp (-A * h) →
      (∀ u v : ℕ, u < 4 * k → v < 4 * k → ∀ l : ℕ,
        1 ≤ l → l ≤ s * h → bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c = 0) →
      ∀ u v : ℕ, u < k → v < k → ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ t * h →
        bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c = 0 := by
  let E : ℝ := A - (C + bakerGridEntryRate L S a b + 1)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ),
    eventually_baker_grid_perturbation (L := L) (S := S) (K := K) (J := (L + 1)^3)
      ha hb hΓ C,
    eventually_bakerMixed_growth (L := L) (K := K) (J := (L + 1)^3) hΓ a C,
    eventually_bakerMixed_grid_step hk hs hst htw a (bakerMixedCircleRate L w a Γ C) E]
    with h hh hpert hgrowth hstep
  intro p q hq hqheight c hc hgamma hdef hzero u v hu hv l hl hlt
  have hcount : bakerColumnCount h L ≤ (L + 1)^3 * h := by
    rw [bakerColumnCount_eq, Nat.mul_comm]
  have herror (i j x : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ K) (hx : x ≤ S * h) :
      ‖bakerIndexedMixed h L i j ((p : ℝ) / q) a c x -
        (((bakerIndexedComparison h L i j x p q a b c : ℚ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
        Real.exp (-E * h) := by
    rw [bakerIndexedMixed_comparison_cast]
    have he := hpert (bakerColumnCount h L) hcount
      (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L)
      (bakerColumnDegree_lt h L) (bakerColumnLam_le h L) (bakerColumnMu_le h L)
      i j x hj hx p q c hc hgamma A hA hdef
    convert he using 1; congr 1; dsimp [E]; ring
  have hvalues (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < 4 * k) (hj : j < 4 * k)
      (x : ℕ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hxs : x ≤ s * h) :
      ‖bakerMixedComplexValue h i j ((p : ℝ) / q) a c
        (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L) x‖ ≤
          Real.exp (-E * h) := by
    have he := herror i j x (by omega)
      (hxs.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right h (hst.trans htS)))
    rw [hzero i j hi hj x hx hxs, Rat.cast_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, sub_zero] at he
    exact he
  have hboundary (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < k) (hj : j < k)
      (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ Metric.sphere 0 ((w * h : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
      ‖bakerMixedComplexValue h i j ((p : ℝ) / q) a c
        (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L) z‖ ≤

@[expose] public section

/-! # Complex growth of the block auxiliary function

The finite coefficient count, coefficient height, polynomial growth and
frequency growth are kept explicit. This estimate is suitable for Cauchy
derivative bounds on circles whose radius scales with the extrapolation grid.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

noncomputable def bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {D : ℕ}
    (h : ℕ) (ω : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i, ∑ d, (c i d : ℂ) * (bakerBlock h d.val).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z *
    Complex.exp ((ω i : ℂ) * z)

theorem complex_exp_frequency_norm_bound (ω Ω R : ℝ) (hΩ : 0 ≤ Ω)
    (hω : |ω| ≤ Ω) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖Complex.exp ((ω : ℂ) * z)‖ ≤ Real.exp (Ω * R) := by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc ((ω : ℂ) * z).re ≤ ‖(ω : ℂ) * z‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
    _ = |ω| * ‖z‖ := by simp
    _ ≤ Ω * R := mul_le_mul hω hz (norm_nonneg _) hΩ

theorem bakerAuxiliaryComplex_norm_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {h D L T : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hD : D ≤ h * (L + 1)) (ω : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ)
    (H Ω : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hΩ : 0 ≤ Ω)
    (hc : ∀ i d, |c i d| ≤ H) (hω : ∀ i, |ω i| ≤ Ω)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (T * h : ℕ)) :
    ‖bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue h ω c z‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * D * H *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 1) * (L + 1)) * Real.exp (Ω * (T * h : ℕ)) := by
  classical
  let B := (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 1) * (L + 1))
  let E := Real.exp (Ω * (T * h : ℕ))
  have hterm (i : ι) (d : Fin D) :
      ‖(c i d : ℂ) * (bakerBlock h d.val).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z *
        Complex.exp ((ω i : ℂ) * z)‖ ≤ H * B * E := by
    simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hb := bakerBlock_norm_le_uniform hh (d.isLt.trans_le hD) z hz
    have he := complex_exp_frequency_norm_bound (ω i) Ω (T * h : ℕ) hΩ (hω i) z hz
    apply mul_le_mul _ he (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hH (by dsimp [B]; positivity))
    exact mul_le_mul (hc i d) hb (norm_nonneg _) hH
  calc ‖bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue h ω c z‖
      ≤ ∑ i, ‖∑ d, (c i d : ℂ) * (bakerBlock h d.val).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z *
          Complex.exp ((ω i : ℂ) * z)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ d : Fin D, H * B * E := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => hterm i d))
    _ = _ := by simp [B, E]; ring

theorem ratPolynomial_eval_complex_real (P : ℚ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    P.eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) (x : ℂ) = (((P.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)).eval x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [Polynomial.map_add, hP, hQ]
  | monomial n a => simp

theorem bakerAuxiliaryComplex_eval_real {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {D : ℕ}
    (h : ℕ) (ω : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue h ω c (x : ℂ) =
      ((exponentialPolynomialEval ω (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i)) x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  classical
  simp [bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue, exponentialPolynomialEval, bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial,
    ratPolynomial_eval_complex_real, eval_finsetSum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.sum_mul, Complex.ofReal_exp]

theorem bakerAuxiliaryComplex_differentiable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {D : ℕ}
    (h : ℕ) (ω : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue h ω c) := by
  classical
  have hpoly (d : Fin D) :
      Differentiable ℂ (fun z => (bakerBlock h d.val).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z) := by
    simpa only [eval₂_eq_eval_map] using
      ((bakerBlock h d.val).map (Rat.castHom ℂ)).differentiable
  unfold bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue
  fun_prop

theorem bakerAuxiliaryComplex_iteratedDeriv_norm_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {h D L T : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hD : D ≤ h * (L + 1))
    (ω : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) (H Ω : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hΩ : 0 ≤ Ω)
    (hc : ∀ i d, |c i d| ≤ H) (hω : ∀ i, |ω i| ≤ Ω)
    (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hz : ‖z‖ + R ≤ (T * h : ℕ)) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv m (bakerAuxiliaryComplexValue h ω c) z‖ ≤
      (m.factorial : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * D * H *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 1) * (L + 1)) * Real.exp (Ω * (T * h : ℕ))) / R ^ m := by
  apply Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le m hR
    (bakerAuxiliaryComplex_differentiable h ω c).diffContOnCl
  intro w hw
  apply bakerAuxiliaryComplex_norm_bound hh hD ω c H Ω hH hΩ hc hω
  have hwz : ‖w - z‖ = R := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hw
  calc ‖w‖ = ‖w - z + z‖ := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ‖w - z‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by rw [hwz]; linarith

end HadamardMultibase

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.BigOperators

@[expose] public section

/-! # Nonvanishing and a zero bound for block auxiliary functions

A nonzero coefficient array gives a nonzero polynomial at some frequency,
because the block polynomials have successive degrees. The real zero-count
theorem therefore applies with an explicit dimension bound.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

noncomputable def bakerRealBlockSequence (h : ℕ) : Polynomial.Sequence ℝ where
  elems' d := (bakerBlock h d).map (Rat.castHom ℝ)
  degree_eq' d := by
    rw [degree_map, degree_eq_natDegree (bakerBlock_ne_zero h d), bakerBlock_natDegree]

theorem bakerRealBlock_linearIndependent (h : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun d => (bakerBlock h d).map (Rat.castHom ℝ)) :=
  (bakerRealBlockSequence h).linearIndependent

noncomputable def bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial {D : ℕ} (h : ℕ) (c : Fin D → ℝ) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∑ d, c d • (bakerBlock h d.val).map (Rat.castHom ℝ)

theorem bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial_eq_zero_iff {D : ℕ} (h : ℕ) (c : Fin D → ℝ) :
    bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h c = 0 ↔ ∀ d, c d = 0 := by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp
      ((bakerRealBlock_linearIndependent h).comp Fin.val Fin.val_injective)) c
  · intro hc
    simp [bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial, hc]

theorem bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial_dimension_le {D : ℕ} (h : ℕ) (c : Fin D → ℝ) :
    polynomialDimension (bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h c) ≤ D := by
  classical
  by_cases hD : D = 0
  · subst D
    simp [bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial]
  by_cases hp : bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h c = 0
  · simp [hp]
  have hdeg : (bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h c).natDegree ≤ D - 1 := by
    apply natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
    intro d _
    apply (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans
    rw [natDegree_map, bakerBlock_natDegree]
    exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt d.isLt
  simp only [polynomialDimension, ite_eq_right hp]
  omega

theorem bakerAuxiliary_nonzero_polynomial {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {D : ℕ}
    (h : ℕ) (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) (hc : ∃ i d, c i d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨i, d, hd⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨i, fun hp => hd ((bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial_eq_zero_iff h (c i)).mp hp d)⟩

theorem bakerAuxiliary_zero_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {D : ℕ}
    (h : ℕ) (ω : ι → ℝ) (hω : Function.Injective ω)
    (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) (hc : ∃ i d, c i d ≠ 0) (S : Finset ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S,
      exponentialPolynomialEval ω (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i)) x = 0) :
    S.card < Fintype.card ι * D := by
  classical
  apply (exponentialPolynomial_finset_zero_bound ω hω _
    (bakerAuxiliary_nonzero_polynomial h c hc) S hS).trans_le
  calc exponentialPolynomialDimension (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i))
      ≤ ∑ _i : ι, D := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial_dimension_le h (c i))
    _ = _ := by simp

theorem irrational_frequency_injective {α β : ℝ} (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hirr : Irrational (β / α)) :
    Function.Injective (fun e : ℕ × ℕ => (e.1 : ℝ) * α + (e.2 : ℝ) * β) := by
  intro e f heq
  change (e.1 : ℝ) * α + (e.2 : ℝ) * β = (f.1 : ℝ) * α + (f.2 : ℝ) * β at heq
  have hsecond : e.2 = f.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hden : ((e.2 : ℤ) - f.2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hdenR : ((e.2 : ℤ) - f.2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hden
    apply hirr.ne_rational ((f.1 : ℤ) - e.1) ((e.2 : ℤ) - f.2)
    push_cast at hdenR ⊢
    apply (eq_div_iff hdenR).mpr
    apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hα)
    calc (β / α * ((e.2 : ℝ) - f.2)) * α = β * ((e.2 : ℝ) - f.2) := by field_simp
      _ = ((f.1 : ℝ) - e.1) * α := by nlinarith
  have hfirst : e.1 = f.1 := by
    have : ((e.1 : ℝ) - (f.1 : ℝ)) * α = 0 := by rw [hsecond] at heq; nlinarith
    have : (e.1 : ℝ) = (f.1 : ℝ) := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hα)
    exact_mod_cast this
  exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond

/-- A nonzero block auxiliary function cannot vanish at every positive integer
up to its dimension bound. This is the final zero-count contradiction used
after analytic extrapolation supplies a sufficiently long grid of zeros. -/
theorem bakerAuxiliary_integer_nonzero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {D T : ℕ}
    (h : ℕ) (ω : ι → ℝ) (hω : Function.Injective ω)
    (c : ι → Fin D → ℝ) (hc : ∃ i d, c i d ≠ 0)
    (hT : Fintype.card ι * D ≤ T) :
    ∃ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ T ∧
      exponentialPolynomialEval ω (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i)) l ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hz (k : Fin T) :
      exponentialPolynomialEval ω (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i)) (k.val + 1 : ℕ) = 0 :=
    hn (k.val + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hcount := exponentialPolynomial_ordered_zero_bound ω hω _
    (bakerAuxiliary_nonzero_polynomial h c hc)
    (fun k : Fin T => ((k.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    (by
      intro i j hij
      change (((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) < (((j.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      exact Nat.cast_lt.mpr (by omega)) hz
  have hdim : exponentialPolynomialDimension (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i)) ≤
      Fintype.card ι * D := by
    calc exponentialPolynomialDimension (fun i => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (c i))
        ≤ ∑ _i : ι, D := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial_dimension_le h (c i))
      _ = _ := by simp
  omega

end HadamardMultibase

/-! # Explicit arithmetic size of the comparison entries

integer node and rational slope visible. Clearing the row denominators

open Polynomial

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_real_abs_le_two_pow (h d u l : ℕ) :
    |(((hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((l + 1 + h) * (d / h) + (l + 1 + d % h)) := by
  have hz : ‖(l : ℂ)‖ ≤ (l : ℝ) := by simp
  have he := bakerBlock_hasse_norm_le_two_pow h d u l (l : ℂ) hz
  have hcast : (hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) (l : ℂ) =
      (((hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℂ) := by
    simp
  rw [hcast, Complex.norm_ratCast] at he
  exact he

theorem rational_slope_abs_bound (q lam mu : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (p : ℤ) :
    |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * p / q| ≤
      (lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * |(p : ℝ)| / q := by
  calc |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * p / q|
      ≤ |(lam : ℝ)| + |(mu : ℝ) * p / q| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg lam),
        abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg mu),
        abs_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < q by exact_mod_cast hq)]

theorem bakerComparison_real_abs_bound {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (h d u v l lam mu : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (a b : ℕ) :
    |((bakerComparisonValue h d u v l lam mu p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((l + 1 + h) * (d / h) + (l + 1 + d % h)) *
        ((lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * |(p : ℝ)| / q) ^ v *
        (a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l) * (b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l) := by
  simp only [bakerComparisonValue, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_add,
    Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_intCast]
  have ha : |(a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l)| = (a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l) := abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  have hb : |(b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l)| = (b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l) := abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, ha, hb, abs_pow]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg b) _)
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg a) _)
  apply mul_le_mul (bakerBlock_hasse_real_abs_le_two_pow h d u l)
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (rational_slope_abs_bound q lam mu hq p) v)
    (by positivity) (by positivity)

end HadamardMultibase

/-!

These are the arithmetic comparison values used when a rational slope p/q
approximates log b / log a. Their common denominator is independent of the
evaluation node and the polynomial degree index. Analytic estimates comparing
these expressions with exponential derivatives are a separate obligation.

namespace HadamardMultibase

noncomputable def bakerComparisonValue (h d u v l lam mu : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (q a b : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval (l : ℚ)) *
    ((lam : ℚ) + (mu : ℚ) * p / q) ^ v *
    (a : ℚ) ^ (lam * l) * (b : ℚ) ^ (mu * l)

theorem bakerComparison_integer_multiple {h q : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hq : 0 < q)
    (d u v l lam mu : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (a b : ℕ) :
    HasIntegerMultiple (Nat.lcmUpto h ^ u * q ^ v)
      (bakerComparisonValue h d u v l lam mu p q a b) := by
  have hp := bakerBlock_hasse_common_denominator hh d u (l : ℤ)
  have hs := (rational_slope_integer_multiple q hq p (lam : ℤ) (mu : ℤ)).pow v
  have hm := (hp.mul hs).mul_int ((a : ℤ) ^ (lam * l) * (b : ℤ) ^ (mu * l))
  simpa [bakerComparisonValue, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hm

theorem bakerComparison_sum_integer_multiple {ι : Type*} {h q : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hq : 0 < q) (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℤ)
    (d lam mu : ι → ℕ) (u v l : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (a b : ℕ) :
    HasIntegerMultiple (Nat.lcmUpto h ^ u * q ^ v)
      (∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ℚ) * bakerComparisonValue h (d i) u v l (lam i) (mu i) p q a b) := by
  apply HasIntegerMultiple.sum
  intro i _
  exact (bakerComparison_integer_multiple hh hq (d i) u v l (lam i) (mu i) p a b).mul_int (c i)

theorem bakerComparison_sum_eq_zero_of_small {ι : Type*} {h q : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hq : 0 < q) (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℤ)
    (d lam mu : ι → ℕ) (u v l : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (a b : ℕ)
    (hsmall : |((∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ℚ) *
      bakerComparisonValue h (d i) u v l (lam i) (mu i) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| <
        1 / ((Nat.lcmUpto h ^ u * q ^ v : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (c i : ℚ) *
      bakerComparisonValue h (d i) u v l (lam i) (mu i) p q a b) = 0 := by
  exact rat_eq_zero_of_small_abs (mul_pos (pow_pos (Nat.lcmUpto_pos h) u) (pow_pos hq v))
    (bakerComparison_sum_integer_multiple hh hq s c d lam mu u v l p a b) hsmall

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerInterpolation

@[expose] public section

/-! # Repeated Cauchy nodes and divided derivatives

The contour stays fixed while the interpolation point varies inside it.
Differentiating the Cauchy transform proves the repeated-node formula at
every interior point, rather than only at the contour's centre.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open scoped Real Topology

noncomputable def cauchyDerivativeIntegral (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (a : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (2 * π * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∮ w in C(0, R), (w - a) ^ (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) * f w

theorem cauchyDerivativeIntegral_zero {R : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R)) {a : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ < R) :
    cauchyDerivativeIntegral R f 0 a = f a := by
  have hmem : a ∈ Metric.ball 0 R := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ha
  simpa [cauchyDerivativeIntegral, smul_eq_mul] using
    hf.two_pi_i_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul hmem

theorem cauchyDerivativeIntegral_hasDerivAt {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : CircleIntegrable f 0 R) (n : ℕ) {a : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ < R) :
    HasDerivAt (cauchyDerivativeIntegral R f n)
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) * cauchyDerivativeIntegral R f (n + 1) a) a := by
  have hboundary : a ∉ Metric.sphere 0 |R| := by
    intro hm
    have he : ‖a‖ = |R| := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hm
    rw [abs_of_pos hR] at he
    linarith
  have he := (Complex.hasDerivAt_circleIntegral_sub_zpow_smul
    (n := -((n : ℤ) + 1)) hf hboundary).const_mul (2 * π * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹
  have hexp : -((n : ℤ) + 1) - 1 = -(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) := by omega
  convert he using 1
  · rfl
  · simp only [cauchyDerivativeIntegral, smul_eq_mul, hexp, Int.cast_neg, neg_neg,
      Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring

theorem cauchyDerivativeIntegral_iteratedDeriv {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R)) (n : ℕ) {a : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ < R) :
    iteratedDeriv n f a = (n.factorial : ℂ) * cauchyDerivativeIntegral R f n a := by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) :=
    hf.continuousOn_ball.mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall
  have hint := hcont.circleIntegrable hR.le
  induction n generalizing a with
  | zero => simp [cauchyDerivativeIntegral_zero hf ha]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hmem : a ∈ Metric.ball 0 R := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ha
    have heq : iteratedDeriv n f =ᶠ[𝓝 a]
        (fun w => (n.factorial : ℂ) * cauchyDerivativeIntegral R f n w) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hmem] with w hw
      exact ih (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw)
    have hd := ((cauchyDerivativeIntegral_hasDerivAt hR hint n ha).const_mul
      (n.factorial : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
    have hder := hd.deriv
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at hder
    simpa only [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hder

theorem cauchyDividedDifference_replicate {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R)) (n : ℕ) {a : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ < R) :
    cauchyDividedDifference R f (List.replicate (n + 1) a) =
      iteratedDeriv n f a / (n.factorial : ℂ) := by
  have hexp : -((n : ℤ) + 1) = -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
  have hi : cauchyDividedDifference R f (List.replicate (n + 1) a) =
      cauchyDerivativeIntegral R f n a := by
    simp only [cauchyDividedDifference, cauchyDerivativeIntegral, cauchyNodeKernel,
      List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate, hexp, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    funext w
    ring
  rw [hi]
  apply (eq_div_iff (show (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero)).mpr
  simpa only [mul_comm] using (cauchyDerivativeIntegral_iteratedDeriv hR hf n ha).symm

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerDenominators
public import HadamardMultibase.SmallRationalValues
public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Chebyshev

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Exponentially bounded common denominators

Mathlib's elementary Chebyshev estimate bounds log lcm(1,...,h) by a constant
times h. Combining it with the block-polynomial construction gives a precise
small-value-to-zero lemma whose denominator cost is independent of the degree
index. The analytic small-value estimate remains a separate obligation.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem baker_lcm_log_bound (h : ℕ) :
    Real.log (Nat.lcmUpto h : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log 4 + 4) * (h : ℝ) := by
  rw [← Chebyshev.psi_eq_log_lcmUpto]
  exact Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem baker_lcm_power_bound (h m : ℕ) :
    (Nat.lcmUpto h : ℝ) ^ m ≤
      Real.exp ((Real.log 4 + 4) * (h : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.lcmUpto h := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lcmUpto_pos h
  calc (Nat.lcmUpto h : ℝ) ^ m =
      Real.exp ((m : ℝ) * Real.log (Nat.lcmUpto h : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.log_pow, Real.exp_log (pow_pos hpos m)]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (baker_lcm_log_bound h) (Nat.cast_nonneg m : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m)
      nlinarith

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_common_denominator {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (a m : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    HasIntegerMultiple (Nat.lcmUpto h ^ m)
      ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval (z : ℚ)) := by
  have hdiv (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjh : j ≤ h) :
      (j : ℤ) ∣ (Nat.lcmUpto h : ℤ) := by
    apply Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
    exact Finset.dvd_lcm (f := id) (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hj, hjh⟩)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := bakerBlock_hasse_integer hh hdiv a m z
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_pow] using hv

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_eq_zero_of_exp_small {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (a m : ℕ) (z : ℤ)
    (hsmall : |(((Polynomial.hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval (z : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| <
      Real.exp (-((Real.log 4 + 4) * (h : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)))) :
    (Polynomial.hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval (z : ℚ) = 0 := by
  apply rat_eq_zero_of_small_abs (pow_pos (Nat.lcmUpto_pos h) m)
    (bakerBlock_hasse_common_denominator hh a m z)
  apply hsmall.trans_le
  rw [Real.exp_neg, ← one_div, Nat.cast_pow]
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lcmUpto_pos h) m)
  exact baker_lcm_power_bound h m

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerPolynomials
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Lifts

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Common denominators independent of the degree index

If every integer from 1 through h divides D, substituting z + D X in a block
polynomial produces integer coefficients, for every integer z. Reading a
Taylor coefficient then clears its divided derivative by D^m, independently
of the block polynomial's degree. No transcendence estimate is assumed.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

theorem bakerDelta_scaled_zero_lift {h : ℕ} {D : ℤ}
    (hD : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ h → (j : ℤ) ∣ D) :
    ∃ P : ℤ[X], P.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) =
      (bakerDelta h).comp (C (D : ℚ) * X) := by
  induction h with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  | succ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := ih (fun j hj hjh => hD j hj (by omega))
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hD (h + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    refine ⟨P * (C d * X + 1), ?_⟩
    have hquot : (h + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹ * D = d := by
      rw [hd]
      push_cast
      field_simp
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul, hP, bakerDelta_succ, mul_comp]
    congr 1
    simp only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, map_X, Polynomial.map_one, add_comp,
      mul_comp, C_comp, X_comp, one_comp]
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, hquot]
    simp

theorem bakerDelta_scaled_translate_lift {h : ℕ} {D : ℤ}
    (hD : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ h → (j : ℤ) ∣ D) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ P : ℤ[X], P.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) =
      (bakerDelta h).comp (C (z : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) := by
  induction h generalizing z with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  | succ h ih =>
    have lower (z : ℤ) := ih (fun j hj hjh => hD j hj (by omega)) z
    have pascal (z : ℤ) :
        (bakerDelta (h + 1)).comp (C ((z + 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) =
          (bakerDelta (h + 1)).comp (C (z : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) +
          (bakerDelta h).comp (C ((z + 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) := by
      have shift : C ((z + 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X =
          (C (z : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) + 1 := by
        simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, map_add, map_one]
        ring
      simpa only [shift] using bakerDelta_pascal h (C (z : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X)
    induction z using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => simpa using bakerDelta_scaled_zero_lift hD
    | succ n hn =>
      obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hn
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := lower ((n : ℤ) + 1)
      refine ⟨P + Q, ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.map_add, hP, hQ, ← pascal]
    | pred n hn =>
      obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hn
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := lower (-(n : ℤ))
      refine ⟨P - Q, ?_⟩
      have h := pascal (-(n : ℤ) - 1)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
      rw [Polynomial.map_sub, hP, hQ]
      exact (eq_sub_of_add_eq h.symm).symm

theorem bakerBlock_scaled_translate_lift {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {D : ℤ}
    (hD : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ h → (j : ℤ) ∣ D) (a : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ P : ℤ[X], P.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) =
      (bakerBlock h a).comp (C (z : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := bakerDelta_scaled_translate_lift hD z
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := bakerDelta_scaled_translate_lift
    (fun j hj hjr => hD j hj (hjr.trans (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt a hh)))) z
  refine ⟨P ^ (a / h) * Q, ?_⟩
  simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, hP, hQ, bakerBlock, mul_comp, pow_comp]

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_integer {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {D : ℤ}
    (hD : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ h → (j : ℤ) ∣ D) (a m : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ v : ℤ, (D : ℚ) ^ m * (hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval (z : ℚ) = v := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := bakerBlock_scaled_translate_lift hh hD a z
  refine ⟨P.coeff m, ?_⟩
  have hc := congrArg (fun Q : ℚ[X] => Q.coeff m) hP
  have hcomp : (bakerBlock h a).comp (C (z : ℚ) + C (D : ℚ) * X) =
      (taylor (z : ℚ) (bakerBlock h a)).comp (C (D : ℚ) * X) := by
    simp only [taylor_apply, comp_assoc, add_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hcomp, coeff_map, comp_C_mul_X_coeff, taylor_coeff] at hc
  simpa only [eq_intCast, mul_comm] using hc.symm

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerPolynomialGrowth
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Polynomial
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Liouville

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Divided derivative bounds

Cauchy's estimate on a unit circle cancels the factorial in the Hasse
derivative. This supplies a bound uniform in the derivative order, using
the previously proved block-polynomial bound on a disk enlarged by one.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

theorem polynomial_iteratedDeriv_eval (P : ℂ[X]) (m : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv m (fun z => P.eval z) = fun z => (derivative^[m] P).eval z := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
    funext z
    rw [Polynomial.deriv, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

theorem polynomial_hasse_norm_le_circle_bound (P : ℂ[X]) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere z 1, ‖P.eval w‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖(hasseDeriv m P).eval z‖ ≤ C := by
  have h := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le m
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) P.differentiable.diffContOnCl hC
  have hid : iteratedDeriv m (fun w => P.eval w) z =
      (m.factorial : ℂ) * (hasseDeriv m P).eval z := by
    rw [polynomial_iteratedDeriv_eval, ← factorial_smul_hasseDeriv]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hid, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast] at h
  simp only [one_pow, div_one] at h
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < m.factorial := by positivity
  nlinarith

/-- The radius is retained explicitly: choosing it proportional to the grid
size avoids an artificial log(grid size) loss in high derivative bounds. -/
theorem polynomial_hasse_norm_le_circle_bound_radius (P : ℂ[X]) (m : ℕ)
    (z : ℂ) (C R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hC : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere z R, ‖P.eval w‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖(hasseDeriv m P).eval z‖ ≤ C / R ^ m := by
  have h := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le m
    hR P.differentiable.diffContOnCl hC
  have hid : iteratedDeriv m (fun w => P.eval w) z =
      (m.factorial : ℂ) * (hasseDeriv m P).eval z := by
    rw [polynomial_iteratedDeriv_eval, ← factorial_smul_hasseDeriv]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hid, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast] at h
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < m.factorial := by positivity
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hpos).mp
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using h

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_norm_le_two_pow (h a m R : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((R + 1 + h) * (a / h) + (R + 1 + a % h)) := by
  rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map, ← hasseDeriv_map]
  apply polynomial_hasse_norm_le_circle_bound
  intro w hw
  rw [← eval₂_eq_eval_map]
  apply bakerBlock_norm_le_two_pow
  have hdist : ‖w - z‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hw
  calc ‖w‖ = ‖w - z + z‖ := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ‖w - z‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((R + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [hdist]; push_cast; linarith

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_norm_le_two_pow_radius (h a m R S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((R + S + h) * (a / h) + (R + S + a % h)) / (S : ℝ) ^ m := by
  rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map, ← hasseDeriv_map]
  apply polynomial_hasse_norm_le_circle_bound_radius _ _ _ _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hS)
  intro w hw
  rw [← eval₂_eq_eval_map]
  apply bakerBlock_norm_le_two_pow
  have hdist : ‖w - z‖ = (S : ℝ) := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hw
  calc ‖w‖ = ‖w - z + z‖ := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ‖w - z‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((R + S : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [hdist]; push_cast; linarith

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_norm_le_uniform {h a L T : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (ha : a < h * (L + 1)) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (T * h : ℕ)) :
    ‖(hasseDeriv m (bakerBlock h a)).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1)) := by
  rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map, ← hasseDeriv_map]
  apply polynomial_hasse_norm_le_circle_bound
  intro w hw
  rw [← eval₂_eq_eval_map]
  have hdist : ‖w - z‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hw
  have hwBound : ‖w‖ ≤ ((T + 1) * h : ℕ) := by
    have hhR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
    calc ‖w‖ = ‖w - z + z‖ := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ ‖w - z‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [hdist]; push_cast at hz ⊢; nlinarith
  simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using (bakerBlock_norm_le_uniform hh ha w hwBound)

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerGridExtrapolation
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Asymptotics

@[expose] public section

/-! # Exponential estimates with a varying grid scale

Fixed polynomial factors are absorbed by increasing the lower threshold on h.
The exponential rates themselves remain explicit, so that the parameter
choice cannot accidentally introduce a height-dependent constant.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

theorem eventually_nat_const_mul_pow_le_exp (C : ℝ) (r : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∀ᶠ h : ℕ in atTop, C * (h : ℝ) ^ r ≤ Real.exp (b * (h : ℝ)) := by
  have ho := (isLittleO_pow_exp_pos_mul_atTop r hb).const_mul_left C
  have he := ho.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  have hn := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually he
  filter_upwards [hn] with h hh
  have hh' : |C * (h : ℝ) ^ r| ≤ Real.exp (b * (h : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), one_mul] using hh
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans hh'

theorem eventually_grid_data_prefactor {k s t : ℕ} :
    ∀ᶠ h : ℕ in atTop,
      ((k * (s * h) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) * (((t * h : ℕ) : ℝ) + (s * h : ℕ))) ^ (k - 1) ≤
      Real.exp (h : ℝ) := by
  let B : ℝ := 2 * (k : ℝ) * ((t : ℝ) + s)
  let C : ℝ := (k : ℝ) * s * (1 + B) ^ (k - 1)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ),
    eventually_nat_const_mul_pow_le_exp C k (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with h hh he
  have hhR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hlin : 1 + B * (h : ℝ) ≤ (1 + B) * h := by nlinarith
  have hp : (1 + B * (h : ℝ)) ^ (k - 1) ≤ ((1 + B) * h) ^ (k - 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hlin _
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · simpa [hk0] using (Real.exp_pos (h : ℝ)).le
  · have heq : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    have hpow : (h : ℝ) ^ k = (h : ℝ) ^ (k - 1) * h := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← heq, pow_succ]
    calc ((k * (s * h) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) * (((t * h : ℕ) : ℝ) + (s * h : ℕ))) ^ (k - 1)
        = (k : ℝ) * s * h * (1 + B * (h : ℝ)) ^ (k - 1) := by dsimp [B]; push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * s * h * (((1 + B) * h) ^ (k - 1)) := by gcongr
      _ = C * (h : ℝ) ^ k := by
        rw [mul_pow, hpow]
        dsimp [C]
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (h : ℝ) := by simpa only [one_mul] using he

theorem geometric_cauchy_remainder_eq_exp {k s t w h : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s) (_hst : s ≤ t) (htw : t < w) (A : ℝ) :
    (((t * h : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((s * h : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (k * (s * h)) *
        (((w * h : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (A * h) /

      ‖iteratedDeriv u f (l : ℂ)‖ / (u.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ε)

    have hjm : j + 1 ≤ k * N := by
      have hjlt : j < k * N := by simpa only [nodes, interpolationGridList_length] using hj
      omega

      interpolationGridList_take k 0 (k * N) (j + 1) hjm]
    exact cauchyGrid_coefficient_bound hR hf hk hNR hε hjet j 0 (by omega)

    f nodes hnodes (fun j => confluentMajorant k j ε)

  simp [bakerRowCount, BakerRow, Fintype.card_prod, pow_two]

  ((bakerColumnEquiv h L).symm j).1.val

noncomputable def bakerColumnLam (h L : ℕ) (j : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L)) : ℕ :=
  ((bakerColumnEquiv h L).symm j).2.1.val

noncomputable def bakerColumnMu (h L : ℕ) (j : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L)) : ℕ :=

    bakerColumnLam h L j ≤ L := by
  have he := ((bakerColumnEquiv h L).symm j).2.1.isLt
  exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ he

theorem bakerColumnMu_le (h L : ℕ) (j : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L)) :
    bakerColumnMu h L j ≤ L := by
  have he := ((bakerColumnEquiv h L).symm j).2.2.isLt
  exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ he

  bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L)

noncomputable def bakerIndexedComparison (h L u v l : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (q a b : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ) : ℚ :=
  ∑ j, (c j : ℚ) * bakerComparisonValue h (bakerColumnDegree h L j) u v l
    (bakerColumnLam h L j) (bakerColumnMu h L j) p q a b

theorem bakerIndexedComparison_integer_multiple {h q : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hq : 0 < q)
    (L u v l : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (a b : ℕ) (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ) :
    HasIntegerMultiple (Nat.lcmUpto h ^ u * q ^ v) (bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c) := by
  apply bakerComparison_sum_integer_multiple hh hq Finset.univ c
    (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L) u v l p a b

theorem bakerIndexedComparison_eq_zero_of_exp_small {h q K : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hq : 0 < q) (hheight : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp h)
    (L u v l : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ K) (hv : v ≤ K) (p : ℤ) (a b : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ)
    (hsmall : |((bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c : ℚ) : ℝ)| <
      Real.exp (-((Real.log 4 + 5) * (K : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)))) :
    bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c = 0 := by
  apply rat_eq_zero_of_small_abs (mul_pos (pow_pos (Nat.lcmUpto_pos h) u) (pow_pos hq v))
    (bakerIndexedComparison_integer_multiple hh hq L u v l p a b c)
  apply hsmall.trans_le
  rw [Real.exp_neg, ← one_div]
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by
    have hp := mul_pos (pow_pos (Nat.lcmUpto_pos h) u) (pow_pos hq v)
    exact_mod_cast hp)
  exact baker_comparison_denominator_exp_bound hheight hu hv

end HadamardMultibase

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerIndexing
public import HadamardMultibase.BakerUniformGrowth

@[expose] public section

/-! # Construction of the initial bounded auxiliary vector

The unknowns run over all block degrees and both frequency indices. The
initial rational equations vanish exactly, and the coefficient bound is
exponential in h with a rate independent of the varying rational slope.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

theorem bakerInitialHeightRate_nonneg {K L a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    0 ≤ bakerInitialHeightRate K L a b := by
  have hab : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((a * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ a * b by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul ha hb)
  have hlog := Real.log_nonneg hab
  have hlog2 := Real.log_pos (show (1 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
  have hlog4 := Real.log_pos (show (1 : ℝ) < 4 by norm_num)
  unfold bakerInitialHeightRate
  positivity

theorem eventually_kernel_ceiling_height (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ h : ℕ in atTop, ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ J * h →
      ((2 * n * ⌈Real.exp (C * h)⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((C + 1) * h) := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ),
    eventually_nat_const_mul_pow_le_exp (4 * (J : ℝ) + 1) 1
      (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with h hh hp
  intro n hn
  have hhR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hnR : (n : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * h := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (C * h) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have hceil : (⌈Real.exp (C * h)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (C * h) := by
    have he := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.exp_pos (C * h)).le).le
    linarith
  have hpoly : 4 * (J : ℝ) * h + 1 ≤ Real.exp (h : ℝ) := by
    calc 4 * (J : ℝ) * h + 1 ≤ (4 * (J : ℝ) + 1) * h := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [pow_one, one_mul] using hp
  calc ((2 * n * ⌈Real.exp (C * h)⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ 4 * (J : ℝ) * h * Real.exp (C * h) + 1 := by push_cast; nlinarith [hceil]
    _ ≤ (4 * (J : ℝ) * h + 1) * Real.exp (C * h) := by nlinarith [hexp]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (h : ℝ) * Real.exp (C * h) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

theorem eventually_exists_initial_baker_auxiliary {K L a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hdim : 2 * K ^ 2 ≤ (L + 1) ^ 3)
    {Γ : ℝ} (hΓ : 1 ≤ Γ) :
    ∀ᶠ h : ℕ in atTop, ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp h →
      ∀ p : ℤ,
      (∀ j : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L),
        |(bakerColumnLam h L j : ℝ) + (bakerColumnMu h L j : ℝ) * p / q| ≤ Γ) →
      ∃ c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ, c ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ j, |(c j : ℝ)| ≤ Real.exp ((bakerInitialHeightRate K L a b + 1) * h)) ∧
        ∀ l u v : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ h → u < K → v < K →
          bakerIndexedComparison h L u v l p q a b c = 0 := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ),
    eventually_bakerComparison_cleared_height (K := K) (L := L) ha hb hΓ,
    eventually_kernel_ceiling_height (bakerInitialHeightRate K L a b)
      (bakerInitialHeightRate_nonneg ha hb) ((L + 1) ^ 3)] with h hh hclear hcoef
  intro q hq hheight p hgamma
  have hhpos : 0 < h := by omega
  let rowEquiv := Fintype.equivFin (BakerRow h K)
  let iu : Fin (bakerRowCount h K) → ℕ := fun r => (rowEquiv.symm r).2.1.val
  let iv : Fin (bakerRowCount h K) → ℕ := fun r => (rowEquiv.symm r).2.2.val
  let il : Fin (bakerRowCount h K) → ℕ := fun r => (rowEquiv.symm r).1.val + 1
  let M : ℕ := ⌈Real.exp (bakerInitialHeightRate K L a b * h)⌉₊
  have hcols : bakerColumnCount h L ≤ (L + 1) ^ 3 * h := by
    rw [bakerColumnCount_eq, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hpos : 0 < bakerColumnCount h L := by rw [bakerColumnCount_eq]; positivity
  have hmn : 2 * bakerRowCount h K ≤ bakerColumnCount h L := by
    rw [bakerRowCount_eq, bakerColumnCount_eq]
    have he := Nat.mul_le_mul_left h hdim
    nlinarith [he]
  have hmatrix (r : Fin (bakerRowCount h K)) (j : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L)) :
      |((Nat.lcmUpto h ^ iu r * q ^ iv r : ℕ) : ℚ) *
        bakerComparisonValue h (bakerColumnDegree h L j) (iu r) (iv r) (il r)
          (bakerColumnLam h L j) (bakerColumnMu h L j) p q a b| ≤ (M : ℚ) := by
    have hilu : il r ≤ h := by have he := (rowEquiv.symm r).1.isLt; dsimp [il]; omega
    have hiu : iu r ≤ K := by have he := (rowEquiv.symm r).2.1.isLt; dsimp [iu]; omega
    have hiv : iv r ≤ K := by have he := (rowEquiv.symm r).2.2.isLt; dsimp [iv]; omega
    have he := hclear q hheight (bakerColumnDegree h L j) (il r) (iu r) (iv r)
      (bakerColumnLam h L j) (bakerColumnMu h L j) (bakerColumnDegree_lt h L j) hilu
      hiu hiv (bakerColumnLam_le h L j) (bakerColumnMu_le h L j) p (hgamma j)
    have he' := he.trans (Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp (bakerInitialHeightRate K L a b * h)))
    exact_mod_cast he'
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hbound, hzero⟩ := exists_bounded_baker_comparison_kernel hhpos hq hpos hmn
    (bakerColumnDegree h L) (bakerColumnLam h L) (bakerColumnMu h L) iu iv il p a b hmatrix
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hj : |(c j : ℝ)| ≤ ((2 * bakerColumnCount h L * M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hbound j
    exact hj.trans (hcoef _ hcols)
  · intro l u v hl hlh hu hv
    let r : BakerRow h K := (⟨l - 1, by omega⟩, ⟨u, hu⟩, ⟨v, hv⟩)
    have he := hzero (rowEquiv r)
    have hlprev : l - 1 + 1 = l := by omega
    simpa [bakerIndexedComparison, iu, iv, il, r, hlprev] using he

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerMixedGrowth

@[expose] public section

/-! # Initial arithmetic height bounds

On the first integer grid l<=h, block degree d<h(L+1) gives exponential
growth in h. Row denominators have the same dependence, uniformly in the
varying rational slope as long as q<=exp(h) and its frequencies are bounded.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem bakerBlock_hasse_real_abs_le_uniform {h d L T l : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hd : d < h * (L + 1)) (u : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ T * h) :
    |(((Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1)) := by
  have hz : ‖(l : ℂ)‖ ≤ ((T * h : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast hl
  have he := bakerBlock_hasse_norm_le_uniform hh hd u (l : ℂ) hz
  have hcast : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) (l : ℂ) =
      (((Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℂ) := by simp
  rw [hcast, Complex.norm_ratCast] at he
  exact he

theorem bakerComparison_grid_abs_bound {h d L T l q a b : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hd : d < h * (L + 1)) (hl : l ≤ T * h) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (u v lam mu : ℕ) (hlam : lam ≤ L) (hmu : mu ≤ L) (p : ℤ)
    {Γ : ℝ} (hΓ : 0 ≤ Γ) (hgamma : |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * p / q| ≤ Γ) :
    |((bakerComparisonValue h d u v l lam mu p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1)) * Γ ^ v * ((a * b : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (L * (T * h)) := by
  have hp := bakerBlock_hasse_real_abs_le_uniform (T := T) hh hd u hl
  have haR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hpa : (a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l) ≤ (a : ℝ) ^ (L * (T * h)) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ haR (Nat.mul_le_mul hlam hl)
  have hpb : (b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ (L * (T * h)) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ hbR (Nat.mul_le_mul hmu hl)
  have haAbs : |(a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l)| = (a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l) := abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  have hbAbs : |(b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l)| = (b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l) := abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  simp only [bakerComparisonValue, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_div,
    Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_intCast]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, haAbs, hbAbs, abs_pow, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow]
  have hpoly : |(((Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h d)).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| *
      |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * p / q| ^ v ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1)) * Γ ^ v :=
    mul_le_mul hp (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hgamma v) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  calc _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1)) * Γ ^ v) *
      (a : ℝ) ^ (L * (T * h)) * (b : ℝ) ^ (L * (T * h)) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem bakerComparison_initial_abs_bound {h d L l q a b : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hd : d < h * (L + 1)) (hl : l ≤ h) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (u v lam mu : ℕ) (hlam : lam ≤ L) (hmu : mu ≤ L) (p : ℤ)
    {Γ : ℝ} (hΓ : 0 ≤ Γ) (hgamma : |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * p / q| ≤ Γ) :
    |((bakerComparisonValue h d u v l lam mu p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * 3 * (L + 1)) * Γ ^ v * ((a * b : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (L * h) := by
  simpa using bakerComparison_grid_abs_bound (T := 1) hh hd (by simpa using hl)
    ha hb u v lam mu hlam hmu p hΓ hgamma

theorem baker_comparison_denominator_exp_bound {h q K u v : ℕ}
    (hq : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp h) (hu : u ≤ K) (hv : v ≤ K) :
    ((Nat.lcmUpto h ^ u * q ^ v : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp ((Real.log 4 + 5) * (K : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) := by
  have hpow : (q : ℝ) ^ v ≤ Real.exp ((v : ℝ) * h) := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hq v
  have hc : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 + 4 := by have := Real.log_pos (show (1 : ℝ) < 4 by norm_num); linarith
  have huR : (u : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have hvR : (v : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hv
  calc ((Nat.lcmUpto h ^ u * q ^ v : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = (Nat.lcmUpto h : ℝ) ^ u * (q : ℝ) ^ v := by push_cast; rfl
    _ ≤ Real.exp ((Real.log 4 + 4) * (h : ℝ) * u) * Real.exp ((v : ℝ) * h) :=
      mul_le_mul (baker_lcm_power_bound h u) hpow (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp (((Real.log 4 + 4) * (u : ℝ) + v) * h) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have huScaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huR hc
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add huScaled hvR) (Nat.cast_nonneg h : (0 : ℝ) ≤ h)
      nlinarith [hm]

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.CauchyIntegral
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-! # Cauchy divided differences for quantitative interpolation

Repeated nodes are permitted. A list of m+1 nodes represents a divided
difference of order m. The symmetric integral definition avoids choosing
between distinct-node and repeated-node formulas during extrapolation.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open scoped Real

noncomputable def cauchyNodeKernel (nodes : List ℂ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((nodes.map (fun a => w - a)).prod)⁻¹

@[simp] theorem cauchyNodeKernel_nil (w : ℂ) : cauchyNodeKernel [] w = 1 := by
  simp [cauchyNodeKernel]

@[simp] theorem cauchyNodeKernel_cons (a : ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) (w : ℂ) :
    cauchyNodeKernel (a :: nodes) w = (w - a)⁻¹ * cauchyNodeKernel nodes w := by
  simp [cauchyNodeKernel, mul_inv_rev, mul_comm]

theorem cauchyNodeKernel_perm {s t : List ℂ} (h : s.Perm t) (w : ℂ) :
    cauchyNodeKernel s w = cauchyNodeKernel t w := by
  unfold cauchyNodeKernel
  rw [(h.map (fun a => w - a)).prod_eq]

theorem cauchyNodeKernel_difference (a b w : ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ)
    (ha : w - a ≠ 0) (hb : w - b ≠ 0) :
    cauchyNodeKernel (a :: nodes) w - cauchyNodeKernel (b :: nodes) w =
      (a - b) * cauchyNodeKernel (a :: b :: nodes) w := by
  simp only [cauchyNodeKernel_cons]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem cauchyNode_ne_boundary {R : ℝ} {a w : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ < R)
    (hw : w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 R) : w - a ≠ 0 := by
  have hwR : ‖w‖ = R := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hw
  intro h
  rw [sub_eq_zero.mp h] at hwR
  linarith

theorem cauchyNodeKernel_continuousOn {R : ℝ} (nodes : List ℂ)
    (hnodes : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ < R) :
    ContinuousOn (cauchyNodeKernel nodes) (Metric.sphere 0 R) := by
  induction nodes with
  | nil =>
    rw [show cauchyNodeKernel ([] : List ℂ) = (fun _ => 1) from funext cauchyNodeKernel_nil]
    exact continuousOn_const
  | cons a nodes ih =>
    have ha := hnodes a (by simp)
    have ht := ih (fun b hb => hnodes b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))
    have hi : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => (w - a)⁻¹) (Metric.sphere 0 R) :=
      (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀ (fun w hw => cauchyNode_ne_boundary ha hw)
    change ContinuousOn (fun w => cauchyNodeKernel (a :: nodes) w) (Metric.sphere 0 R)
    simpa only [cauchyNodeKernel_cons, Pi.mul_def] using hi.mul ht

noncomputable def cauchyDividedDifference (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (2 * π * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∮ w in C(0, R), f w * cauchyNodeKernel nodes w

theorem cauchyDividedDifference_perm (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) {s t : List ℂ} (h : s.Perm t) :
    cauchyDividedDifference R f s = cauchyDividedDifference R f t := by
  unfold cauchyDividedDifference
  congr 1
  congr 1
  funext w
  rw [cauchyNodeKernel_perm h]

theorem cauchyDividedDifference_singleton {R : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R)) {a : ℂ} (ha : ‖a‖ < R) :
    cauchyDividedDifference R f [a] = f a := by
  have hmem : a ∈ Metric.ball 0 R := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ha
  simpa [cauchyDividedDifference, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
    hf.two_pi_i_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul hmem

theorem cauchyDividedDifference_recurrence {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R)) (a b : ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ < R) (hb : ‖b‖ < R) (hnodes : ∀ x ∈ nodes, ‖x‖ < R) :
    (a - b) * cauchyDividedDifference R f (a :: b :: nodes) =
      cauchyDividedDifference R f (a :: nodes) - cauchyDividedDifference R f (b :: nodes) := by
  have hia : CircleIntegrable (fun w => f w * cauchyNodeKernel (a :: nodes) w) 0 R :=
    (hf.mul (cauchyNodeKernel_continuousOn _ (by simpa using And.intro ha hnodes))).circleIntegrable hR
  have hib : CircleIntegrable (fun w => f w * cauchyNodeKernel (b :: nodes) w) 0 R :=
    (hf.mul (cauchyNodeKernel_continuousOn _ (by simpa using And.intro hb hnodes))).circleIntegrable hR
  have hi : (∮ w in C(0, R), f w * cauchyNodeKernel (a :: nodes) w) -
      (∮ w in C(0, R), f w * cauchyNodeKernel (b :: nodes) w) =
      (a - b) * ∮ w in C(0, R), f w * cauchyNodeKernel (a :: b :: nodes) w := by
    rw [← circleIntegral.integral_sub hia hib, ← circleIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply circleIntegral.integral_congr hR
    intro w hw
    dsimp only
    rw [← mul_sub, cauchyNodeKernel_difference a b w nodes
      (cauchyNode_ne_boundary ha hw) (cauchyNode_ne_boundary hb hw)]
    ring
  unfold cauchyDividedDifference
  rw [← mul_sub, hi]
  ring

theorem cauchyNodeKernel_norm_bound {R r : ℝ} (hR : r < R) (nodes : List ℂ)
    (hnodes : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ ≤ r) (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 R) :
    ‖cauchyNodeKernel nodes w‖ ≤ 1 / (R - r) ^ nodes.length := by
  have hpos : 0 < R - r := sub_pos.mpr hR
  have hwR : ‖w‖ = R := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hw
  induction nodes with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a nodes ih =>
    have ha := hnodes a (by simp)
    have ht := ih (fun b hb => hnodes b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))
    have hd : R - r ≤ ‖w - a‖ := by
      have := norm_sub_norm_le w a
      rw [hwR] at this
      linarith
    have hinv : ‖(w - a)⁻¹‖ ≤ (R - r)⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv]
      exact inv_anti₀ hpos hd
    rw [cauchyNodeKernel_cons, norm_mul, List.length_cons]
    calc ‖(w - a)⁻¹‖ * ‖cauchyNodeKernel nodes w‖ ≤
        (R - r)⁻¹ * (1 / (R - r) ^ nodes.length) :=
          mul_le_mul hinv ht (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp

theorem cauchyDividedDifference_norm_bound {R r M : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hrR : r < R)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) (hnodes : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ ≤ r)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 R, ‖f w‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f nodes‖ ≤ R * M / (R - r) ^ nodes.length := by
  change ‖(2 * π * Complex.I : ℂ)⁻¹ •
    ∮ w in C(0, R), f w * cauchyNodeKernel nodes w‖ ≤ _
  have hb : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 R,
      ‖f w * cauchyNodeKernel nodes w‖ ≤ M / (R - r) ^ nodes.length := by
    intro w hw
    rw [norm_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hk : ‖cauchyNodeKernel nodes w‖ ≤ ((R - r) ^ nodes.length)⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [one_div] using (cauchyNodeKernel_norm_bound hrR nodes hnodes w hw)
    exact mul_le_mul (hf w hw) hk (norm_nonneg _) hM
  have he := circleIntegral.norm_two_pi_i_inv_smul_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hR hb
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using he

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerConfluentInterpolation

@[expose] public section

/-! # Confluent integer grids

The grid repeats each positive integer k times. Contiguous windows satisfy
the divided-difference recurrence; their endpoint separation controls its
denominator and supplies factorial decay beyond order k-1.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

def interpolationGridNode (k s : ℕ) : ℕ := s / k + 1

noncomputable def interpolationGridList (k s count : ℕ) : List ℂ :=
  (List.range count).map (fun j => (interpolationGridNode k (s + j) : ℂ))

@[simp] theorem interpolationGridList_length (k s count : ℕ) :
    (interpolationGridList k s count).length = count := by
  simp [interpolationGridList]

@[simp] theorem interpolationGridList_zero (k s : ℕ) : interpolationGridList k s 0 = [] := by
  simp [interpolationGridList]

theorem interpolationGridList_succ (k s count : ℕ) :
    interpolationGridList k s (count + 1) =
      (interpolationGridNode k s : ℂ) :: interpolationGridList k (s + 1) count := by
  simp only [interpolationGridList, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map,
    Nat.add_zero]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro j _
  simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]

theorem interpolationGridList_append_last (k s count : ℕ) :
    interpolationGridList k s (count + 1) = interpolationGridList k s count ++
      [(interpolationGridNode k (s + count) : ℂ)] := by
  simp [interpolationGridList, List.range_succ]

theorem interpolationGridList_take (k s count j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ count) :
    (interpolationGridList k s count).take j = interpolationGridList k s j := by
  unfold interpolationGridList
  rw [← List.map_take, List.take_range, Nat.min_eq_left hj]

theorem interpolationGridNode_mono (k : ℕ) : Monotone (interpolationGridNode k) := by
  intro s t hst
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.div_le_div_right hst) 1

theorem interpolationGridList_eq_replicate {k s n : ℕ}
    (he : interpolationGridNode k s = interpolationGridNode k (s + n)) :
    interpolationGridList k s (n + 1) =
      List.replicate (n + 1) (interpolationGridNode k s : ℂ) := by
  have hmem : ∀ a ∈ interpolationGridList k s (n + 1), a = (interpolationGridNode k s : ℂ) := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
    have hjn : j ≤ n := by have := List.mem_range.mp hj; omega
    have hlo := interpolationGridNode_mono k (Nat.le_add_right s j)
    have hhi := interpolationGridNode_mono k (Nat.add_le_add_left hjn s)
    rw [← he] at hhi
    congr 1
    omega
  have heq := List.eq_replicate_length.mpr hmem
  simpa only [interpolationGridList_length] using heq

theorem interpolationGridNode_lt_multiplicity {k s n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (he : interpolationGridNode k s = interpolationGridNode k (s + n)) : n < k := by
  have hq : s / k = (s + n) / k := by simpa [interpolationGridNode] using he
  have hstart := Nat.div_add_mod s k
  have hend := Nat.div_add_mod (s + n) k
  have hrem := Nat.mod_lt (s + n) hk
  rw [← hq] at hend
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (s % k)]

theorem interpolationGridNode_separation {k s n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    n + 1 - k ≤ k * (interpolationGridNode k (s + n) - interpolationGridNode k s) := by
  have hmono := interpolationGridNode_mono k (Nat.le_add_right s n)
  have hstart := Nat.div_add_mod s k
  have hend := Nat.div_add_mod (s + n) k
  have hrem := Nat.mod_lt (s + n) hk
  have hquot : s / k ≤ (s + n) / k := Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_add_right s n)
  have hdiff : (s + n) / k - s / k =
      interpolationGridNode k (s + n) - interpolationGridNode k s := by
    simp [interpolationGridNode]
  have hsplit : (s + n) / k = ((s + n) / k - s / k) + s / k := by omega
  rw [hsplit] at hend
  rw [← hdiff]
  by_cases hn : n + 1 ≤ k
  · omega
  · have hsub : n + 1 - k + k = n + 1 := by omega
    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (s % k)]

theorem interpolationGridNode_le {k N s : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hs : s < k * N) :
    1 ≤ interpolationGridNode k s ∧ interpolationGridNode k s ≤ N := by
  have hq : s / k < N := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hk).mpr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hs)
  exact ⟨Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _), Nat.succ_le_of_lt hq⟩

theorem interpolationGridList_norm_le {k N s count : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hs : s + count ≤ k * N) :
    ∀ a ∈ interpolationGridList k s count, ‖a‖ ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
  have hjc := List.mem_range.mp hj
  have hnode := (interpolationGridNode_le hk (show s + j < k * N by omega)).2
  simpa only [Complex.norm_natCast] using (show (interpolationGridNode k (s + j) : ℝ) ≤ N by exact_mod_cast hnode)

theorem interpolationGrid_cauchy_recurrence {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R)) {k N s n : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hs : s + (n + 2) ≤ k * N) (hNR : (N : ℝ) < R) :
    ((interpolationGridNode k (s + n + 1) : ℂ) - interpolationGridNode k s) *
      cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 2)) =
      cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k (s + 1) (n + 1)) -
        cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 1)) := by
  let a : ℂ := interpolationGridNode k s
  let b : ℂ := interpolationGridNode k (s + n + 1)
  let middle := interpolationGridList k (s + 1) n
  have ha : ‖a‖ < R := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hNR
    have he : (interpolationGridNode k s : ℝ) ≤ N := by
      exact_mod_cast (interpolationGridNode_le hk (show s < k * N by omega)).2
    simpa only [a, Complex.norm_natCast] using he
  have hb : ‖b‖ < R := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hNR
    have he : (interpolationGridNode k (s + n + 1) : ℝ) ≤ N := by
      exact_mod_cast (interpolationGridNode_le hk (show s + n + 1 < k * N by omega)).2
    simpa only [b, Complex.norm_natCast] using he
  have hm : ∀ x ∈ middle, ‖x‖ < R := fun x hx =>
    (interpolationGridList_norm_le hk (show s + 1 + n ≤ k * N by omega) x hx).trans_lt hNR
  have hfull : (interpolationGridList k s (n + 2)).Perm (b :: a :: middle) := by
    rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega, interpolationGridList_append_last,
      interpolationGridList_succ]
    exact List.perm_append_comm
  have htail : (interpolationGridList k (s + 1) (n + 1)).Perm (b :: middle) := by
    rw [interpolationGridList_append_last]
    convert (List.perm_append_comm : (middle ++ [b]).Perm ([b] ++ middle)) using 1 <;>
      simp [middle, b, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
  rw [cauchyDividedDifference_perm R f hfull, cauchyDividedDifference_perm R f htail,
    interpolationGridList_succ]
  exact cauchyDividedDifference_recurrence hR hf b a middle hb ha hm

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-! # Factorial majorants for confluent divided differences

Integer spacing yields a factor 2 at low orders. At orders beyond the node
multiplicity k, endpoint separation grows at least as (n+1-k)/k, supplying
the factorial denominator needed for stability uniformly in the grid length.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

noncomputable def confluentMajorant (k n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ε * (2 * (k : ℝ)) ^ n / ((n + 1 - k).factorial : ℝ)

theorem confluentMajorant_nonneg (k n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    0 ≤ confluentMajorant k n ε := by
  unfold confluentMajorant
  positivity

theorem le_confluentMajorant_of_lt {k n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hn : n < k)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : ε ≤ confluentMajorant k n ε := by
  have he : n + 1 - k = 0 := by omega
  simp only [confluentMajorant, he, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one]
  apply le_mul_of_one_le_right hε
  apply one_le_pow₀
  have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  linarith

theorem confluentMajorant_step {k n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) {ε d : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hsep : ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * d) :
    2 * confluentMajorant k n ε / d ≤ confluentMajorant k (n + 1) ε := by
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by linarith
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hprev := confluentMajorant_nonneg k n hε
  have hnext := confluentMajorant_nonneg k (n + 1) hε
  by_cases hg : n + 2 ≤ k
  · have hzero : n + 1 - k = 0 := by omega
    have hzero' : n + 1 + 1 - k = 0 := by omega
    have he : confluentMajorant k (n + 1) ε = 2 * (k : ℝ) * confluentMajorant k n ε := by
      simp only [confluentMajorant, hzero, hzero', Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_succ]
      ring
    calc 2 * confluentMajorant k n ε / d ≤ 2 * confluentMajorant k n ε :=
        div_le_self (by positivity) hd
      _ ≤ confluentMajorant k (n + 1) ε := by
        rw [he]
        have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
        nlinarith
  · have hsucc : n + 1 + 1 - k = (n + 1 - k) + 1 := by omega
    have hfact : (((n + 1 - k).factorial : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hnpos : (((n + 1 - k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have he : ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * confluentMajorant k (n + 1) ε =
        2 * (k : ℝ) * confluentMajorant k n ε := by
      simp only [confluentMajorant, hsucc, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul,
        Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
      field_simp
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsep hnext
    rw [he] at hb
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).mpr
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hkpos).mp
    nlinarith [hb]

theorem confluentMajorant_mul_pow_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (n : ℕ) {ε A : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    confluentMajorant k n ε * A ^ n ≤
      ε * (1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) * A) ^ (k - 1) * Real.exp (2 * (k : ℝ) * A) := by
  let x := 2 * (k : ℝ) * A
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; positivity
  have hindex : n + 1 - k = n - (k - 1) := by omega
  have hcoeff : confluentMajorant k n ε * A ^ n =
      ε * (x ^ n / ((n - (k - 1)).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    simp only [confluentMajorant, hindex, x, mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [hcoeff]
  have hb : x ^ n / ((n - (k - 1)).factorial : ℝ) ≤
      (1 + x) ^ (k - 1) * Real.exp x := by
    by_cases hn : n < k - 1
    · have hzero : n - (k - 1) = 0 := by omega
      rw [hzero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one]
      calc x ^ n ≤ (1 + x) ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx (by linarith) _
        _ ≤ (1 + x) ^ (k - 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) hn.le
        _ ≤ _ := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) (Real.one_le_exp hx)
    · have hs : n = (k - 1) + (n - (k - 1)) := by omega
      rw [hs, pow_add]
      have hexp := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp x hx (n - (k - 1))
      have hpow : x ^ (k - 1) ≤ (1 + x) ^ (k - 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx (by linarith) _
      calc x ^ (k - 1) * x ^ (n - (k - 1)) /
          (((k - 1 + (n - (k - 1)) - (k - 1)).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ)
          = x ^ (k - 1) * (x ^ (n - (k - 1)) / ((n - (k - 1)).factorial : ℝ)) := by
            rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_assoc]
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hpow hexp (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hε
  simpa only [mul_assoc, x] using hh

end HadamardMultibase
