/-
Copyright (c) 2026 Joshua Mark. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
-/
module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerInterpolationGrid
public import HadamardMultibase.BakerInterpolationMajorant

@[expose] public section

/-! # Stability of interpolation from small derivative data

The constants depend on the multiplicity k, while the order-dependent
factorial controls arbitrarily long integer grids. This is a quantitative
estimate: the original derivative data need only be small, not exactly zero.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem cauchyGrid_constant_window_bound {R ε : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R))
    {k N s n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hs : s + (n + 1) ≤ k * N) (hNR : (N : ℝ) < R)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hjet : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ N → ∀ u : ℕ, u < k →
      ‖iteratedDeriv u f (l : ℂ)‖ / (u.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ε)
    (he : interpolationGridNode k s = interpolationGridNode k (s + n)) :
    ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 1))‖ ≤
      confluentMajorant k n ε := by
  have hn : n < k := interpolationGridNode_lt_multiplicity hk he
  have hnode := interpolationGridNode_le hk (show s < k * N by omega)
  have hnodeR : ‖(interpolationGridNode k s : ℂ)‖ < R := by
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast]
    exact (show (interpolationGridNode k s : ℝ) ≤ N by exact_mod_cast hnode.2).trans_lt hNR
  calc ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 1))‖
      = ‖iteratedDeriv n f (interpolationGridNode k s : ℂ)‖ / (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
        rw [interpolationGridList_eq_replicate he,
          cauchyDividedDifference_replicate hR hf n hnodeR, norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast]
    _ ≤ ε := hjet _ hnode.1 hnode.2 n hn
    _ ≤ confluentMajorant k n ε := le_confluentMajorant_of_lt hk hn hε

theorem cauchyGrid_coefficient_bound {R ε : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R))
    {k N : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hNR : (N : ℝ) < R) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hjet : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ N → ∀ u : ℕ, u < k →
      ‖iteratedDeriv u f (l : ℂ)‖ / (u.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ε)
    (n s : ℕ) (hs : s + (n + 1) ≤ k * N) :
    ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 1))‖ ≤
      confluentMajorant k n ε := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    apply cauchyGrid_constant_window_bound hR hf hk hs hNR hε hjet
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases he : interpolationGridNode k s = interpolationGridNode k (s + (n + 1))
    · exact cauchyGrid_constant_window_bound hR hf hk hs hNR hε hjet he
    have hmono : interpolationGridNode k s ≤ interpolationGridNode k (s + (n + 1)) :=
      interpolationGridNode_mono k (Nat.le_add_right s (n + 1))
    let gap := interpolationGridNode k (s + (n + 1)) - interpolationGridNode k s
    have hgap : 1 ≤ gap := by dsimp [gap]; omega
    have hgapR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ gap := by exact_mod_cast hgap
    have hgapPos : (0 : ℝ) < gap := by linarith
    have hhead := ih s (show s + (n + 1) ≤ k * N by omega)
    have htail := ih (s + 1) (show s + 1 + (n + 1) ≤ k * N by omega)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) :=
      hf.continuousOn_ball.mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall
    have hrec := interpolationGrid_cauchy_recurrence hR.le hcont hk
      (show s + (n + 2) ≤ k * N by omega) hNR
    simp only [Nat.add_assoc] at hrec
    have hnorm : ‖(interpolationGridNode k (s + (n + 1)) : ℂ) - interpolationGridNode k s‖ =
        (gap : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_sub hmono, Complex.norm_natCast]
    have hbound : (gap : ℝ) *
        ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 2))‖ ≤
        2 * confluentMajorant k n ε := by
      calc (gap : ℝ) * ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 2))‖
          = ‖((interpolationGridNode k (s + (n + 1)) : ℂ) - interpolationGridNode k s) *
              cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 2))‖ := by
                rw [norm_mul, hnorm]
        _ = _ := congrArg norm hrec
        _ ≤ ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k (s + 1) (n + 1))‖ +
            ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 1))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ _ := by linarith
    have hsep : ((n + 2 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * (gap : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (interpolationGridNode_separation (s := s) (n := n + 1) hk)
    calc ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (interpolationGridList k s (n + 1 + 1))‖
        ≤ 2 * confluentMajorant k n ε / (gap : ℝ) := by
          apply (le_div_iff₀ hgapPos).mpr
          nlinarith [hbound]
      _ ≤ confluentMajorant k (n + 1) ε := confluentMajorant_step hk hε hgapR hsep

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Transcendental.Liouville.LiouvilleWith
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Asymptotics
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-! # Reducing the final contradiction to exponentially small grid defects

An assumed Liouville ratio supplies arbitrarily large denominators. Its
approximation exponent can be chosen after all fixed auxiliary parameters,
so that h=ceil(log q) gives any required exponential accuracy in h.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

theorem liouville_tiny_grid_approximation {α : ℝ} (hL : Liouville α)
    {y A : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hA : 0 < A) (H : ℕ) :
    ∃ h q : ℕ, H ≤ h ∧ 1 < q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp h ∧
      ∃ p : ℤ, |(p : ℝ) / q| ≤ |α| + 1 ∧
        |y * ((p : ℝ) / q - α)| < Real.exp (-A * h) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * A + 1)
  have hfreq := hL.frequently_exists_num n
  have hlarge : ∀ᶠ q : ℕ in atTop,
      2 ≤ q ∧ max y (Real.exp (max (1 : ℝ) (H : ℝ))) ≤ (q : ℝ) :=
    (eventually_ge_atTop 2).and
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop _)
  obtain ⟨q, ⟨p, _, herr⟩, hqNat, hqLarge⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually hlarge).exists
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ q by omega)
  have hyq : y ≤ (q : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hqLarge
  have hqexp : Real.exp (max (1 : ℝ) (H : ℝ)) ≤ q := (le_max_right _ _).trans hqLarge
  have hlog : max (1 : ℝ) (H : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (q : ℝ) := by
    have he := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hqexp
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using he
  have hlogone : 1 ≤ Real.log (q : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hlog
  have hlogH : (H : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (q : ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hlog
  let h : ℕ := ⌈Real.log (q : ℝ)⌉₊
  have hceil : Real.log (q : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hH : H ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hlogH.trans hceil
  have htwolog : (h : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (q : ℝ) := by
    have he := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ Real.log (q : ℝ) by linarith)).le
    dsimp [h]
    linarith
  have hheight : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (h : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Real.exp_log hqpos] using (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hceil)
  have hpower : 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ n ≤ 1 := by
    exact (div_le_one (pow_pos hqpos n)).mpr (one_le_pow₀ hqone)
  have herrone : |α - (p : ℝ) / q| < 1 := herr.trans_le hpower
  have habs : |(p : ℝ) / q| ≤ |α| + 1 := by
    have he : (p : ℝ) / q = α - (α - (p : ℝ) / q) := by ring
    calc |(p : ℝ) / q| = |α - (α - (p : ℝ) / q)| := congrArg abs he
      _ ≤ |α| + |α - (p : ℝ) / q| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith
  have hpowexp : (q : ℝ) * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ n) =
      Real.exp ((1 - (n : ℝ)) * Real.log (q : ℝ)) := by
    have hp : 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ n = Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ))) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hqpos]
      simp only [one_div]
    calc (q : ℝ) * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ n) =
          Real.exp (Real.log (q : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ))) := by
            rw [hp, Real.exp_log hqpos]
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  refine ⟨h, q, hH, by omega, hheight, p, habs, ?_⟩
  calc
    |y * ((p : ℝ) / q - α)| = y * |α - (p : ℝ) / q| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hy, abs_sub_comm]
    _ < y * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ n) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left herr hy
    _ ≤ (q : ℝ) * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ n) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hyq (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp ((1 - (n : ℝ)) * Real.log (q : ℝ)) := hpowexp
    _ < Real.exp (-2 * A * Real.log (q : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-A * h) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerPerturbation
public import HadamardMultibase.BakerAuxiliaryGrowth
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.IteratedDeriv.Lemmas

@[expose] public section

/-! # Analytic mixed auxiliary functions and their derivatives

Differentiating on the diagonal raises one of the two mixed indices. The
recurrence controls univariate jets using the rectangular comparison system.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

theorem derivative_hasseDeriv_succ (P : ℚ[X]) (u : ℕ) :
    (hasseDeriv u P).derivative = (u + 1) • hasseDeriv (u + 1) P := by
  have he := congrArg (fun T : ℚ[X] →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ[X] => T P) (hasseDeriv_comp (R := ℚ) 1 u)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hasseDeriv_one,
    Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.add_comm] using he

theorem hassePolynomial_eval_hasDerivAt (P : ℚ[X]) (u : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => (hasseDeriv u P).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) w)
      ((u + 1 : ℕ) * (hasseDeriv (u + 1) P).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z) z := by
  simpa [eval₂_eq_eval_map, derivative_map, derivative_hasseDeriv_succ, nsmul_eq_mul] using
    ((hasseDeriv u P).map (Rat.castHom ℂ)).hasDerivAt z

noncomputable def bakerMixedComplexValue {n : ℕ} (h u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j, (c j : ℂ) * (hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h (d j))).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z *
    (((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ v *
      Complex.exp (((((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z)

theorem bakerMixedComplex_hasDerivAt {n : ℕ} (h u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu)
      ((u + 1 : ℕ) * bakerMixedComplexValue h (u + 1) v β a c d lam mu z +
        (Real.log a : ℂ) * bakerMixedComplexValue h u (v + 1) β a c d lam mu z) z := by
  classical
  have hj (j : Fin n) :=
    (((hassePolynomial_eval_hasDerivAt (bakerBlock h (d j)) u z).const_mul (c j : ℂ)).mul_const
      ((((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ v)).mul
        (((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul
          (((((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a : ℝ) : ℂ))).cexp)
  convert HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hj j) using 1
  · rfl
  · simp only [bakerMixedComplexValue, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul, pow_succ, id_eq, mul_one]
    ring

theorem bakerMixedComplex_differentiable {n : ℕ} (h u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu) :=
  fun z => (bakerMixedComplex_hasDerivAt h u v β a c d lam mu z).differentiableAt

theorem bakerMixedComplex_deriv {n : ℕ} (h u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) :
    deriv (bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu) =
      fun z => (u + 1 : ℕ) * bakerMixedComplexValue h (u + 1) v β a c d lam mu z +
        (Real.log a : ℂ) * bakerMixedComplexValue h u (v + 1) β a c d lam mu z := by
  funext z
  exact (bakerMixedComplex_hasDerivAt h u v β a c d lam mu z).deriv

theorem bakerMixedComplex_eval_real {n : ℕ} (h u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu (x : ℂ) =
      ((bakerMixedRealValue h u v β a c d lam mu x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  unfold bakerMixedComplexValue bakerMixedRealValue
  push_cast
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [ratPolynomial_eval_complex_real]
  simp only [eval₂_eq_eval_map]

theorem bakerMixedComplex_iteratedDeriv_bound {n K : ℕ} (h : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) (z : ℂ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hvalues : ∀ i j : ℕ, i + j ≤ K → ‖bakerMixedComplexValue h i j β a c d lam mu z‖ ≤ ε)
    (r u v : ℕ) (hbudget : u + v + r ≤ K) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv r (bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu) z‖ ≤
      ((K : ℝ) + |Real.log a|) ^ r * ε := by
  induction r generalizing u v with
  | zero => simpa using hvalues u v (by omega)
  | succ r ih =>
    have hfirst := ih (u + 1) v (by omega)
    have hsecond := ih u (v + 1) (by omega)
    have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℂ r
        (fun w => ((u + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * bakerMixedComplexValue h (u + 1) v β a c d lam mu w) z :=
      ((bakerMixedComplex_differentiable h (u + 1) v β a c d lam mu).const_mul _).contDiff.contDiffAt
    have hc2 : ContDiffAt ℂ r
        (fun w => (Real.log a : ℂ) * bakerMixedComplexValue h u (v + 1) β a c d lam mu w) z :=
      ((bakerMixedComplex_differentiable h u (v + 1) β a c d lam mu).const_mul _).contDiff.contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', bakerMixedComplex_deriv,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_add hc1 hc2, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
    calc ‖((u + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r
            (bakerMixedComplexValue h (u + 1) v β a c d lam mu) z +
          (Real.log a : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r
            (bakerMixedComplexValue h u (v + 1) β a c d lam mu) z‖
        ≤ ((u + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((K : ℝ) + |Real.log a|) ^ r * ε) +
            |Real.log a| * (((K : ℝ) + |Real.log a|) ^ r * ε) := by
          apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
          simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfirst (by positivity))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecond (abs_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ ((K : ℝ) + |Real.log a|) ^ (r + 1) * ε := by
        have huK : ((u + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast (show u + 1 ≤ K by omega)
        have hp : 0 ≤ ((K : ℝ) + |Real.log a|) ^ r * ε := by positivity
        have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right huK hp
        rw [pow_succ]
        nlinarith [he]

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerMixedDerivatives

@[expose] public section

/-! # Uniform growth for the mixed auxiliary family

The polynomial bound is independent of the Hasse derivative order. The
remaining index dependence is the explicit slope power Gamma^v.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem bounded_slope_frequency {L lam mu : ℕ} {β K : ℝ}
    (_hK : 0 ≤ K) (hβ : |β| ≤ K) (hlam : lam ≤ L) (hmu : mu ≤ L) :
    |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * β| ≤ (L : ℝ) * (1 + K) := by
  calc |(lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * β| ≤ |(lam : ℝ)| + |(mu : ℝ) * β| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = (lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * |β| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg lam), abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg mu)]
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ) + (L : ℝ) * K := by
      have h1 : (lam : ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast hlam
      have h2 : (mu : ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast hmu
      exact add_le_add h1 (mul_le_mul h2 hβ (abs_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem bakerMixedComplex_norm_bound {n h L T : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) (hd : ∀ j, d j < h * (L + 1))
    (u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℤ)
    (H Γ : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hΓ : 0 ≤ Γ)
    (hc : ∀ j, |(c j : ℝ)| ≤ H)
    (hgamma : ∀ j, |(lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β| ≤ Γ)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (T * h : ℕ)) :
    ‖bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu z‖ ≤
      (n : ℝ) * H * (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1)) * Γ ^ v *
        Real.exp (Γ * |Real.log a| * ((T * h : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  let B := (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 2) * (L + 1))
  let E := Real.exp (Γ * |Real.log a| * ((T * h : ℕ) : ℝ))
  have hterm (j : Fin n) :
      ‖(c j : ℂ) * (Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h (d j))).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z *
        (((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ v *
        Complex.exp (((((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z)‖ ≤
      H * B * Γ ^ v * E := by
    have hp := bakerBlock_hasse_norm_le_uniform hh (hd j) u z hz
    have hfreq : |((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a| ≤ Γ * |Real.log a| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgamma j) (abs_nonneg _)
    have he := complex_exp_frequency_norm_bound
      (((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a)
      (Γ * |Real.log a|) ((T * h : ℕ) : ℝ) (by positivity) hfreq z hz
    have hcNorm : ‖(c j : ℂ)‖ ≤ H := by simpa using hc j
    simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply mul_le_mul _ he (norm_nonneg _) (by dsimp [B]; positivity)
    apply mul_le_mul _ (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hgamma j) v) (by positivity)
      (mul_nonneg hH (by dsimp [B]; positivity))
    exact mul_le_mul hcNorm hp (norm_nonneg _) hH
  calc ‖bakerMixedComplexValue h u v β a c d lam mu z‖
      ≤ ∑ j, ‖(c j : ℂ) * (Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h (d j))).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z *
          (((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ v *
          Complex.exp (((((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a : ℝ) : ℂ) * z)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, H * B * Γ ^ v * E := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm j)
    _ = _ := by simp [B, E]; ring

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerInterpolation

@[expose] public section

/-! # Newton expansion with a Cauchy remainder

Nodes may repeat. The contour definition of the coefficients makes the
expansion valid without separate cases for confluent nodes. Its remainder
has an explicit geometric bound in the number of interpolation nodes.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

noncomputable def newtonNodeProduct (nodes : List ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (nodes.map (fun a => z - a)).prod

@[simp] theorem newtonNodeProduct_nil (z : ℂ) : newtonNodeProduct [] z = 1 := by
  simp [newtonNodeProduct]

@[simp] theorem newtonNodeProduct_cons (a : ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    newtonNodeProduct (a :: nodes) z = (z - a) * newtonNodeProduct nodes z := by
  simp [newtonNodeProduct]

@[simp] theorem newtonNodeProduct_reverse (nodes : List ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    newtonNodeProduct nodes.reverse z = newtonNodeProduct nodes z := by
  simp [newtonNodeProduct, List.map_reverse, List.prod_reverse]

@[simp] theorem cauchyDividedDifference_reverse (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) :
    cauchyDividedDifference R f nodes.reverse = cauchyDividedDifference R f nodes :=
  cauchyDividedDifference_perm R f nodes.reverse_perm

noncomputable def cauchyNewtonRemainder (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ)
    (nodes : List ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  newtonNodeProduct nodes z * cauchyDividedDifference R f (z :: nodes)

noncomputable def cauchyNewtonExpansion (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : List ℂ → List ℂ → ℂ → ℂ
  | _, [], _ => 0
  | headNodes, a :: nodes, z =>
      newtonNodeProduct headNodes z * cauchyDividedDifference R f (a :: headNodes) +
        cauchyNewtonExpansion R f (a :: headNodes) nodes z

theorem cauchyNewtonExpansion_eq_sum (R : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (headNodes nodes : List ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    cauchyNewtonExpansion R f headNodes nodes z =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range nodes.length,
        newtonNodeProduct ((nodes.take j).reverse ++ headNodes) z *
          cauchyDividedDifference R f ((nodes.take (j + 1)).reverse ++ headNodes) := by
  induction nodes generalizing headNodes with
  | nil => simp [cauchyNewtonExpansion]
  | cons a nodes ih =>
    rw [cauchyNewtonExpansion, ih]
    simp only [List.length_cons, Finset.sum_range_succ', List.take_zero,
      List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.take_succ_cons, List.reverse_cons,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    exact add_comm _ _

theorem cauchyNewtonRemainder_step {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R)) (headNodes : List ℂ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ headNodes, ‖a‖ < R) (a z : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ < R) (hz : ‖z‖ < R) :
    cauchyNewtonRemainder R f headNodes z =
      newtonNodeProduct headNodes z * cauchyDividedDifference R f (a :: headNodes) +
        cauchyNewtonRemainder R f (a :: headNodes) z := by
  have hs := cauchyDividedDifference_recurrence hR hf z a headNodes hz ha hp
  unfold cauchyNewtonRemainder
  rw [newtonNodeProduct_cons]
  linear_combination -newtonNodeProduct headNodes z * hs

theorem cauchyNewtonExpansion_identity {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R)) (headNodes nodes : List ℂ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ headNodes, ‖a‖ < R) (hn : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ < R)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < R) :
    cauchyNewtonRemainder R f headNodes z = cauchyNewtonExpansion R f headNodes nodes z +
      cauchyNewtonRemainder R f (nodes.reverse ++ headNodes) z := by
  induction nodes generalizing headNodes with
  | nil => simp [cauchyNewtonExpansion]
  | cons a nodes ih =>
    have ha := hn a (by simp)
    have ht := ih (a :: headNodes) (by simpa using And.intro ha hp)
      (fun b hb => hn b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))
    rw [cauchyNewtonRemainder_step hR hf headNodes hp a z ha hz, ht]
    simp only [cauchyNewtonExpansion, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    ring

theorem cauchyNewton_formula {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R)) (nodes : List ℂ)
    (hn : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ < R) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ < R) :
    f z = cauchyNewtonExpansion R f [] nodes z +
      cauchyNewtonRemainder R f nodes.reverse z := by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) :=
    hf.continuousOn_ball.mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall
  have he := cauchyNewtonExpansion_identity hR hcont [] nodes (by simp) hn z hz
  simpa only [cauchyNewtonRemainder, newtonNodeProduct_nil, one_mul,
    cauchyDividedDifference_singleton hf hz, List.append_nil] using he

theorem newtonNodeProduct_norm_bound {r ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ + r)
    (nodes : List ℂ) (hnodes : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ ≤ r) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ) :
    ‖newtonNodeProduct nodes z‖ ≤ (ρ + r) ^ nodes.length := by
  induction nodes with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a nodes ih =>
    have ha := hnodes a (by simp)
    have ht := ih (fun b hb => hnodes b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))
    have hza : ‖z - a‖ ≤ ρ + r := (norm_sub_le z a).trans (add_le_add hz ha)
    rw [newtonNodeProduct_cons, norm_mul, List.length_cons, pow_succ']
    exact mul_le_mul hza ht (norm_nonneg _) hρ

theorem cauchyNewtonRemainder_norm_bound {R r ρ M : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρR : ρ < R)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) (hnodes : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ ≤ r)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere 0 R, ‖f w‖ ≤ M)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ) :
    ‖cauchyNewtonRemainder R f nodes z‖ ≤
      (ρ + r) ^ nodes.length * (R * M / (R - ρ) ^ (nodes.length + 1)) := by
  have hp := newtonNodeProduct_norm_bound (show 0 ≤ ρ + r by linarith) nodes hnodes z hz
  have hd := cauchyDividedDifference_norm_bound hR hρR f (z :: nodes)
    (by simpa using And.intro hz (fun a ha => (hnodes a ha).trans hrρ)) hM hf
  unfold cauchyNewtonRemainder
  rw [norm_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul hp _ (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
  simpa using hd

theorem cauchyNewtonExpansion_norm_bound {R r ρ : ℝ} (hρr : 0 ≤ ρ + r)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (nodes : List ℂ) (hnodes : ∀ a ∈ nodes, ‖a‖ ≤ r)
    (B : ℕ → ℝ) (_hB : ∀ j, 0 ≤ B j)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j < nodes.length,
      ‖cauchyDividedDifference R f (nodes.take (j + 1))‖ ≤ B j)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ) :
    ‖cauchyNewtonExpansion R f [] nodes z‖ ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range nodes.length, (ρ + r) ^ j * B j := by
  rw [cauchyNewtonExpansion_eq_sum]
  simp only [List.append_nil, newtonNodeProduct_reverse, cauchyDividedDifference_reverse]
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j hj
  have hjlen : j < nodes.length := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
  have hlen : (nodes.take j).length = j := by simp [List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hjlen.le]
  have hp := newtonNodeProduct_norm_bound hρr (nodes.take j)
    (fun a ha => hnodes a (List.mem_of_mem_take ha)) z hz
  rw [hlen] at hp
  rw [norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul hp (hcoeff j hjlen) (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hρr _)

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerArithmeticStep

@[expose] public section

/-! # Fixed parameters for the twenty-step extrapolation -/
namespace HadamardMultibase

def bakerWidth (v : ℕ) : ℕ := v ^ 6
def bakerBudget (v j : ℕ) : ℕ := 4 ^ (20 - j) * v ^ 8
def bakerGridScale (v j : ℕ) : ℕ := v ^ j

theorem bakerBudget_step (v j : ℕ) (hj : j < 20) :
    bakerBudget v j = 4 * bakerBudget v (j + 1) := by
  unfold bakerBudget
  have he : 20 - j = (20 - (j + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  rw [he, pow_succ']
  ring

theorem bakerBudget_pos {v j : ℕ} (hv : 0 < v) : 0 < bakerBudget v j := by
  unfold bakerBudget
  positivity

theorem bakerBudget_le_initial (v j : ℕ) : bakerBudget v j ≤ bakerBudget v 0 := by
  unfold bakerBudget
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.sub_le _ _)

theorem bakerBudget_grid_dominates {v j : ℕ} (hv : 4 ≤ v) (hj : j < 20) :
    bakerBudget v 0 ≤ 4 * bakerBudget v (j + 1) * bakerGridScale v j := by
  have hj19 : j ≤ 19 := by omega
  have he : 20 - (j + 1) + j = 19 := by omega
  have hp : 4 ^ j ≤ v ^ j := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hv j
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (4 ^ (20 - (j + 1))) hp
  rw [← pow_add, he] at hm
  unfold bakerBudget bakerGridScale
  have hm2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (4 * v ^ 8) hm
  norm_num only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.reducePow] at hm2 ⊢
  nlinarith [hm2]

theorem bakerWidth_outer_dominated (v j : ℕ) :
    bakerWidth v * bakerGridScale v (j + 2) ≤
      bakerBudget v (j + 1) * bakerGridScale v j := by
  have hpow : v ^ 6 * v ^ (j + 2) = v ^ 8 * v ^ j := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  unfold bakerWidth bakerGridScale bakerBudget
  rw [hpow]
  have hfour : 1 ≤ 4 ^ (20 - (j + 1)) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
  nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right (v ^ 8 * v ^ j) hfour]

theorem baker_final_grid_large {v : ℕ} (hv : 4 ≤ v) :
    (bakerWidth v + 1) ^ 3 ≤ bakerGridScale v 20 := by
  have hv1 : 1 ≤ v := by omega
  have hp : 1 ≤ v ^ 6 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hv1
  have hcube : (v ^ 6 + 1) ^ 3 ≤ (2 * v ^ 6) ^ 3 := by gcongr; omega
  have hsq : 8 ≤ v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (v ^ 18) hsq
  have he : (2 * v ^ 6) ^ 3 = 8 * v ^ 18 := by ring
  have he2 : v ^ 2 * v ^ 18 = v ^ 20 := by ring
  unfold bakerWidth bakerGridScale
  exact hcube.trans (by simpa only [he, he2] using hm)

theorem baker_initial_equations_fewer {v : ℕ} (hv : 2 * 4 ^ 20 ≤ v) :
    2 * bakerBudget v 0 ^ 2 ≤ (bakerWidth v + 1) ^ 3 := by
  have hsq : 2 * (4 : ℕ) ^ 40 ≤ v ^ 2 := by
    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hv 2
    norm_num at hp ⊢
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (v ^ 16) hsq
  have he : v ^ 2 * v ^ 16 = v ^ 18 := by ring
  rw [he] at hm
  have hcube : v ^ 18 ≤ (v ^ 6 + 1) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      v ^ 18 = (v ^ 6) ^ 3 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; omega
  unfold bakerBudget bakerWidth
  norm_num only [Nat.sub_zero]
  calc
    2 * (4 ^ 20 * v ^ 8) ^ 2 = (2 * 4 ^ 40) * v ^ 16 := by ring
    _ ≤ v ^ 18 := hm
    _ ≤ _ := hcube

theorem baker_grid_log_ratio {v : ℕ} (hv : 4 ≤ v) (j : ℕ) :
    Real.log (((bakerGridScale v (j + 1) : ℝ) + bakerGridScale v j) /
      ((bakerGridScale v (j + 2) : ℝ) - bakerGridScale v (j + 1))) ≤
        Real.log 2 - Real.log v := by
  have hvR : (4 : ℝ) ≤ v := by exact_mod_cast hv
  have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := by linarith
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (v : ℝ) ^ j := pow_pos hv0 _
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (v : ℝ)^2 - v := by nlinarith
  have he : (((bakerGridScale v (j + 1) : ℝ) + bakerGridScale v j) /
      ((bakerGridScale v (j + 2) : ℝ) - bakerGridScale v (j + 1))) =
      ((v : ℝ) + 1) / ((v : ℝ)^2 - v) := by
    unfold bakerGridScale
    push_cast
    rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    norm_num
    field_simp
  rw [he, ← Real.log_div (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hv0.ne']
  apply (Real.log_le_log_iff (div_pos (by linarith) hden) (div_pos (by norm_num) hv0)).mpr
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden hv0).mpr
  nlinarith

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerComparisonGrowth
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential

@[expose] public section

/-! # Perturbing logarithmic frequencies

At integer nodes, replacing the true logarithm ratio by p/q changes each
arithmetic comparison entry by an exponential factor. The error is bounded
explicitly in the coefficient height, entry bound and logarithmic defect.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem log_frequency_exp_factor {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (β : ℝ) (lam mu l : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (((lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a * l) =
      (a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l) * (b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l) *
        Real.exp ((mu * l : ℕ) * (β * Real.log a - Real.log b)) := by
  have haR : (0 : ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have he : ((lam : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a * l =
      ((lam * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log a + ((mu * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log b +
        ((mu * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * (β * Real.log a - Real.log b) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_nat_mul,
    Real.exp_log haR, Real.exp_log hbR]

noncomputable def bakerMixedRealValue {n : ℕ} (h u v : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (a : ℕ)
    (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, (c j : ℝ) * (Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h (d j))).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℝ) x *
    ((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) ^ v *
      Real.exp (((lam j : ℝ) + (mu j : ℝ) * β) * Real.log a * x)

theorem bakerMixedRealValue_at_integer {n : ℕ} {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h u v l q : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ) :
    bakerMixedRealValue h u v ((p : ℝ) / q) a c d lam mu l =
      ∑ j, (c j : ℝ) * ((bakerComparisonValue h (d j) u v l (lam j) (mu j) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp ((mu j * l : ℕ) * (((p : ℝ) / q) * Real.log a - Real.log b)) := by
  unfold bakerMixedRealValue
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [log_frequency_exp_factor ha hb]
  have heval : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h (d j))).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℝ) (l : ℝ) =
      (((Polynomial.hasseDeriv u (bakerBlock h (d j))).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by simp
  rw [heval]
  simp only [bakerComparisonValue, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_div,
    Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_intCast, mul_div_assoc]
  ring

theorem finite_exp_perturbation_bound {n : ℕ} (A t : Fin n → ℝ)
    {H T : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (_hT : 0 ≤ T) (hT1 : T ≤ 1)
    (hA : ∀ j, |A j| ≤ H) (ht : ∀ j, |t j| ≤ T) :
    |(∑ j, A j * Real.exp (t j)) - ∑ j, A j| ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * H * T := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc |∑ j, (A j * Real.exp (t j) - A j)|
      ≤ ∑ j, |A j * Real.exp (t j) - A j| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, 2 * H * T := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      have he : A j * Real.exp (t j) - A j = A j * (Real.exp (t j) - 1) := by ring
      rw [he, abs_mul]
      have hexp := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le ((ht j).trans hT1)
      have hexp' : |Real.exp (t j) - 1| ≤ 2 * T := hexp.trans (by linarith [ht j])
      have hmul := mul_le_mul (hA j) hexp' (abs_nonneg _) hH
      nlinarith [hmul]
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

theorem bakerMixedRealValue_comparison_error {n : ℕ} {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h u v l q L : ℕ) (p : ℤ) (c : Fin n → ℤ) (d lam mu : Fin n → ℕ)
    (H B : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hc : ∀ j, |(c j : ℝ)| ≤ H)
    (hentry : ∀ j, |((bakerComparisonValue h (d j) u v l (lam j) (mu j) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤ B)
    (hmu : ∀ j, mu j ≤ L)
    (hsmall : ((L * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * |((p : ℝ) / q) * Real.log a - Real.log b| ≤ 1) :
    |bakerMixedRealValue h u v ((p : ℝ) / q) a c d lam mu l -
      ∑ j, (c j : ℝ) * ((bakerComparisonValue h (d j) u v l (lam j) (mu j) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      2 * (n : ℝ) * H * B * ((L * l : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        |((p : ℝ) / q) * Real.log a - Real.log b| := by
  rw [bakerMixedRealValue_at_integer ha hb]
  let η := ((p : ℝ) / q) * Real.log a - Real.log b
  have hA (j) : |(c j : ℝ) *
      ((bakerComparisonValue h (d j) u v l (lam j) (mu j) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤ H * B := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hc j) (hentry j) (abs_nonneg _) hH
  have ht (j) : |((mu j * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * η| ≤ ((L * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * |η| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_right l (hmu j)) (abs_nonneg _)
  have he := finite_exp_perturbation_bound
    (fun j => (c j : ℝ) * ((bakerComparisonValue h (d j) u v l (lam j) (mu j) p q a b : ℚ) : ℝ))
    (fun j => ((mu j * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * η) (mul_nonneg hH hB) (by positivity) hsmall hA ht
  simpa only [η, mul_assoc] using he

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerPolynomials
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Growth bounds for the auxiliary block polynomials

On a complex disk of integral radius R the ordinary binomial polynomial is
bounded by choose(R+n,n). Grouping into blocks then gives an exponential bound
linear in the block size, with no extra log(block size) factor.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

theorem bakerDelta_norm_le_choose (n R : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(bakerDelta n).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤ ((R + n).choose n : ℝ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (bakerDelta (n + 1)).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z =
        (bakerDelta n).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z * (z + (n + 1 : ℕ)) := by
      have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z) (bakerDelta_nsmul_succ n)
      simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using h
    have hn := congrArg norm he
    simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast] at hn
    have hlin : ‖z + (n + 1 : ℕ)‖ ≤ (R + n + 1 : ℕ) := by
      calc ‖z + (n + 1 : ℕ)‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ _ := by
          have hnorm : ‖(n : ℂ) + 1‖ = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
            simpa using Complex.norm_natCast (n + 1)
          simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          rw [hnorm]
          linarith
    have hc : ((R + n + 1).choose (n + 1) : ℝ) * (n + 1 : ℕ) =
        (R + n + 1 : ℕ) * ((R + n).choose n : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (R + n) n).symm
    have hbound := mul_le_mul ih hlin (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    rw [← hn] at hbound
    have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    have hcast : R + (n + 1) = R + n + 1 := by omega
    rw [hcast]
    nlinarith

theorem bakerDelta_norm_le_two_pow (n R : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(bakerDelta n).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (R + n) := by
  apply (bakerDelta_norm_le_choose n R z hz).trans
  exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_le_two_pow (R + n) n

theorem bakerBlock_norm_le_two_pow (h a R : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(bakerBlock h a).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((R + h) * (a / h) + (R + a % h)) := by
  simp only [bakerBlock, eval₂_mul, eval₂_pow, norm_mul, norm_pow]
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (bakerDelta_norm_le_two_pow h R z hz) _)
    (bakerDelta_norm_le_two_pow (a % h) R z hz) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)

theorem bakerBlock_norm_le_uniform {h a L T : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (ha : a < h * (L + 1)) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (T * h : ℕ)) :
    ‖(bakerBlock h a).eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℂ) z‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (h * (T + 1) * (L + 1)) := by
  apply (bakerBlock_norm_le_two_pow h a (T * h) z hz).trans
  apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
  have hq : a / h ≤ L := by
    have := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hh).mpr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using ha)
    omega
  have hr := Nat.mod_lt a hh
  calc (T * h + h) * (a / h) + (T * h + a % h)
      ≤ (T * h + h) * (a / h + 1) := by nlinarith
    _ ≤ (T * h + h) * (L + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.add_le_add_right hq 1)
    _ = h * (T + 1) * (L + 1) := by ring

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Binomial
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Sequence
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Integer-valued auxiliary polynomials

The ordinary binomial polynomial is `Δ_n(X) = (X+1)⋯(X+n)/n!`.
For a positive block size `h`, write a degree index `a = qh+r` and use
`Δ_h(X)^q Δ_r(X)`. This separates the degree from the denominator block size,
as in the classical auxiliary-polynomial approach to logarithmic forms.

All results in this module are proved from mathlib. No transcendence estimate
is imported.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Polynomial

noncomputable def bakerDelta (n : ℕ) : ℚ[X] :=
  Ring.multichoose (X + 1 : ℚ[X]) n

@[simp] theorem bakerDelta_zero : bakerDelta 0 = 1 := by
  simp [bakerDelta]

@[simp] theorem bakerDelta_one : bakerDelta 1 = X + 1 := by
  simp [bakerDelta]

theorem bakerDelta_comp (n : ℕ) (P : ℚ[X]) :
    (bakerDelta n).comp P = Ring.multichoose (P + 1) n := by
  simpa [bakerDelta] using Ring.map_multichoose (compRingHom P) (X + 1) n

theorem bakerDelta_eval (n : ℕ) (z : ℚ) :
    (bakerDelta n).eval z = Ring.multichoose (z + 1) n := by
  simpa [bakerDelta] using Ring.map_multichoose (evalRingHom z) (X + 1) n

theorem bakerDelta_pascal (n : ℕ) (P : ℚ[X]) :
    (bakerDelta (n + 1)).comp (P + 1) =
      (bakerDelta (n + 1)).comp P + (bakerDelta n).comp (P + 1) := by
  simp only [bakerDelta_comp]
  exact Ring.multichoose_succ_succ (P + 1) n

/-- Integer values are obtained without clearing a factorial-sized denominator. -/
theorem bakerDelta_eval_int (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    (bakerDelta n).eval (z : ℚ) = (Ring.multichoose (z + 1) n : ℤ) := by
  rw [bakerDelta_eval]
  simpa using (Ring.map_multichoose (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (z + 1) n).symm

theorem bakerDelta_integerValued (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ v : ℤ, (bakerDelta n).eval (z : ℚ) = (v : ℚ) :=
  ⟨Ring.multichoose (z + 1) n, bakerDelta_eval_int n z⟩

theorem bakerDelta_nsmul_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1) • bakerDelta (n + 1) = bakerDelta n * (X + (n + 1 : ℚ[X])) := by
  apply nsmul_right_injective (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  calc n.factorial • ((n + 1) • bakerDelta (n + 1))
      = (n + 1).factorial • bakerDelta (n + 1) := by
        rw [smul_smul, Nat.factorial, Nat.mul_comm n.factorial]
    _ = (ascPochhammer ℕ (n + 1)).smeval (X + 1 : ℚ[X]) :=
      Ring.factorial_nsmul_multichoose_eq_ascPochhammer _ _
    _ = (ascPochhammer ℕ n).smeval (X + 1 : ℚ[X]) * (X + (n + 1 : ℚ[X])) := by
      rw [ascPochhammer_succ_right, smeval_mul]
      simp only [smeval_add, smeval_X, smeval_natCast]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = n.factorial • (bakerDelta n * (X + (n + 1 : ℚ[X]))) := by
      rw [← Ring.factorial_nsmul_multichoose_eq_ascPochhammer]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, bakerDelta]

theorem bakerDelta_succ (n : ℕ) :
    bakerDelta (n + 1) = bakerDelta n * (C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) * X + 1) := by
  have hn : (n + 1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hlin : (n + 1 : ℚ[X]) * (C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) * X + 1) =
      X + (n + 1 : ℚ[X]) := by
    have hc : (n + 1 : ℚ[X]) * C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) = 1 := by
      simpa using congrArg (C : ℚ →+* ℚ[X]) (mul_inv_cancel₀ hn)
    linear_combination X * hc
  apply nsmul_right_injective (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  change (n + 1) • bakerDelta (n + 1) =
    (n + 1) • (bakerDelta n * (C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) * X + 1))
  rw [bakerDelta_nsmul_succ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [mul_left_comm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hlin]

theorem bakerDelta_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : bakerDelta n ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (eval (0 : ℚ)) h
  have hone : (bakerDelta n).eval 0 = 1 := by
    rw [bakerDelta_eval]
    simp
  rw [hone, eval_zero] at he
  exact one_ne_zero he

theorem bakerDelta_natDegree (n : ℕ) : (bakerDelta n).natDegree = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hd : (C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) * X + 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree = 1 := by
      rw [← C_1, natDegree_add_C, natDegree_C_mul_X _ (inv_ne_zero (by positivity))]
    have hn : (C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) * X + 1 : ℚ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
      exact ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt (show 0 <
        (C ((n + 1 : ℚ)⁻¹) * X + 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree by rw [hd]; decide)
    rw [bakerDelta_succ, natDegree_mul (bakerDelta_ne_zero n) hn, ih, hd]

/-- Degree-indexed block polynomials. The useful parameter regime is `0 < h`;
the definition itself is total, using the natural quotient and remainder. -/
noncomputable def bakerBlock (h a : ℕ) : ℚ[X] :=
  bakerDelta h ^ (a / h) * bakerDelta (a % h)

@[simp] theorem bakerBlock_zero (h : ℕ) : bakerBlock h 0 = 1 := by
  simp [bakerBlock]

theorem bakerBlock_of_lt {h a : ℕ} (ha : a < h) :
    bakerBlock h a = bakerDelta a := by
  simp [bakerBlock, Nat.div_eq_of_lt ha, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha]

theorem bakerBlock_integerValued (h a : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ v : ℤ, (bakerBlock h a).eval (z : ℚ) = (v : ℚ) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := bakerDelta_integerValued h z
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := bakerDelta_integerValued (a % h) z
  refine ⟨u ^ (a / h) * v, ?_⟩
  simp only [bakerBlock, eval_mul, eval_pow, hu, hv, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow]

theorem bakerBlock_ne_zero (h a : ℕ) : bakerBlock h a ≠ 0 :=
  mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (bakerDelta_ne_zero _)) (bakerDelta_ne_zero _)

theorem bakerBlock_natDegree (h a : ℕ) :
    (bakerBlock h a).natDegree = a := by
  rw [bakerBlock, natDegree_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (bakerDelta_ne_zero _))
    (bakerDelta_ne_zero _), natDegree_pow, bakerDelta_natDegree, bakerDelta_natDegree]
  simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod a h

/-- The block family spans every finite degree range through Mathlib's
polynomial-sequence basis theorem. -/
noncomputable def bakerBlockSequence (h : ℕ) : Polynomial.Sequence ℚ where
  elems' := bakerBlock h
  degree_eq' a := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (bakerBlock_ne_zero h a), bakerBlock_natDegree]

theorem bakerBlock_linearIndependent (h : ℕ) : LinearIndependent ℚ (bakerBlock h) := by
  exact (bakerBlockSequence h).linearIndependent

end HadamardMultibase

module

@[expose] public section

/-! # Rate inequalities independent of the varying height -/
namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem baker_circle_rate_linear {K L w a b : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}
    (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hLK : L ≤ K)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hC : Real.log 4 + 5 + 10 * Real.log 2 + Real.log ((a * b : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3 ≤ C)
    (hCB : 2 * Real.log 2 + (1 + B) * |Real.log a| ≤ C) :
    bakerMixedCircleRate L w a ((L : ℝ) * (1 + B))
      (bakerInitialHeightRate K L a b + 1) ≤
        C * K + C * L * w := by
  have hlog2 : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hlog4 : 0 ≤ Real.log (4 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hab : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((a * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ a * b by nlinarith)
  have hlogab := Real.log_nonneg hab
  have hLR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast hL

        (Γ ^ K * Real.exp (bakerGridEntryRate L S a b * h)) * ((L * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * |η|

        Real.exp (C * h) * Real.exp (bakerGridEntryRate L S a b * h) * |η| := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (h : ℝ) * Real.exp (C * h) *
        Real.exp (bakerGridEntryRate L S a b * h) * Real.exp (-A * h) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.BakerIndexing
public import HadamardMultibase.GeneralIndependence

@[expose] public section

/-! # The exact zero-grid contradiction

The zeroth comparison sum has the true integer logarithmic frequencies.
Reindexing its nonzero coefficient vector into block polynomials lets the
checked exponential-polynomial zero count exclude a grid of sufficient size.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

noncomputable def bakerGroupedCoefficients (h L : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ)
    (freq : Fin (L + 1) × Fin (L + 1)) (d : Fin (h * (L + 1))) : ℝ :=
  (c (bakerColumnEquiv h L (d, freq)) : ℝ)

noncomputable def bakerTrueFrequency (a b L : ℕ) (freq : Fin (L + 1) × Fin (L + 1)) : ℝ :=
  (freq.1.val : ℝ) * Real.log a + (freq.2.val : ℝ) * Real.log b

theorem bakerTrueFrequency_injective {a b : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (b : ℝ) / Real.log (a : ℝ))) (L : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (bakerTrueFrequency a b L) := by
  have hloga : Real.log (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < a by omega))).ne'
  intro i j he
  have hp : (i.1.val, i.2.val) = (j.1.val, j.2.val) :=
    irrational_frequency_injective hloga hirr he
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact Fin.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hp)
  · exact Fin.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hp)

theorem bakerGroupedCoefficients_ne_zero {h L : ℕ}
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∃ freq d, bakerGroupedCoefficients h L c freq d ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  apply hc
  funext j
  let col := (bakerColumnEquiv h L).symm j
  have he := hn col.2 col.1
  dsimp [bakerGroupedCoefficients, col] at he
  simp only [Prod.mk.eta, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at he
  simpa using (show c j = 0 by exact_mod_cast he)

theorem true_log_frequency_exp {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (lam mu l : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (((lam : ℝ) * Real.log a + (mu : ℝ) * Real.log b) * l) =
      (a : ℝ) ^ (lam * l) * (b : ℝ) ^ (mu * l) := by
  have he : ((lam : ℝ) * Real.log a + (mu : ℝ) * Real.log b) * l =
      ((lam * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log a + ((mu * l : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log b := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_nat_mul,
    Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast ha : (0 : ℝ) < a),
    Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast hb : (0 : ℝ) < b)]

theorem bakerIndexedComparison_zero_eq_auxiliary {h L a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ) (l q : ℕ) (p : ℤ) :
    ((bakerIndexedComparison h L 0 0 l p q a b c : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      exponentialPolynomialEval (bakerTrueFrequency a b L)
        (fun freq => bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial h (bakerGroupedCoefficients h L c freq)) l := by
  classical
  simp only [bakerIndexedComparison, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_mul]
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (bakerColumnEquiv h L)]
  simp only [bakerColumnDegree, bakerColumnLam, bakerColumnMu, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    bakerComparisonValue, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero, LinearMap.id_apply, pow_zero,
    mul_one, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_natCast]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  unfold exponentialPolynomialEval bakerAuxiliaryPolynomial bakerGroupedCoefficients
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro freq _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  rw [bakerTrueFrequency, true_log_frequency_exp ha hb]
  have heval : (((bakerBlock h d.val).eval (l : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ((bakerBlock h d.val).map (Rat.castHom ℝ)).eval (l : ℝ) := by
    simp [← Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map]
  rw [heval]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem bakerIndexedComparison_zero_grid_impossible {h L a b T : ℕ}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (b : ℝ) / Real.log (a : ℝ)))
    (c : Fin (bakerColumnCount h L) → ℤ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hT : bakerColumnCount h L ≤ T) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ T → bakerIndexedComparison h L 0 0 l p q a b c = 0) : False := by
  classical
  have hdim : Fintype.card (Fin (L + 1) × Fin (L + 1)) * (h * (L + 1)) ≤ T := by
    simpa [bakerColumnCount, BakerColumn, Fintype.card_prod, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hT
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlT, hne⟩ := bakerAuxiliary_integer_nonzero h (bakerTrueFrequency a b L)
    (bakerTrueFrequency_injective ha hirr L) (bakerGroupedCoefficients h L c)
    (bakerGroupedCoefficients_ne_zero c hc) hdim
  apply hne
  rw [← bakerIndexedComparison_zero_eq_auxiliary (show 0 < a by omega) (show 0 < b by omega) c l q p,
    hzero l hl hlT, Rat.cast_zero]

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pigeonhole
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-!
# A finite-box form of Siegel's elementary construction

An integer matrix whose images of a sufficiently large box fit in a smaller
box has two equal images. Their difference is a bounded nonzero integer kernel
vector. The cardinality inequality and coefficient bound are explicit.
-/

namespace HadamardMultibase

open scoped BigOperators

theorem integer_row_box_bound {n H M : ℕ} (a : Fin n → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ j, |a j| ≤ (M : ℤ)) (x : Fin n → Fin (H + 1)) :
    |∑ j, a j * (x j : ℕ)| ≤ (n * M * H : ℕ) := by
  calc |∑ j, a j * (x j : ℕ)| ≤ ∑ j, |a j * (x j : ℕ)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, (M : ℤ) * H := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ (x j : ℕ) by positivity)]
      have hx : ((x j : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (x j).isLt)
      exact mul_le_mul (ha j) hx (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

/-- Explicit finite-box criterion for a small nonzero integer kernel vector. -/
theorem exists_bounded_integer_kernel {m n H M : ℕ} (A : Fin m → Fin n → ℤ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ (M : ℤ))
    (hcount : (2 * (n * M * H) + 1) ^ m < (H + 1) ^ n) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℤ, v ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ j, |v j| ≤ (H : ℤ)) ∧
      ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j * v j = 0 := by
  classical
  let B : ℕ := n * M * H
  let F : (Fin n → Fin (H + 1)) → (Fin m → Fin (2 * B + 1)) := fun x i =>
    ⟨(∑ j, A i j * (x j : ℕ) + (B : ℤ)).toNat, by
      apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
      apply Int.toNat_le.mpr
      have hu : (∑ j, A i j * (x j : ℕ)) ≤ (B : ℤ) :=
        (le_abs_self _).trans (integer_row_box_bound (A i) (hA i) x)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        (show (∑ j, A i j * (x j : ℕ)) + (B : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (B : ℤ) by linarith)⟩
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin m → Fin (2 * B + 1)) <
      Fintype.card (Fin n → Fin (H + 1)) := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, B] using hcount
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hF⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt F hcard
  let v : Fin n → ℤ := fun j => ((x j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y j : ℕ) : ℤ)
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hv
    apply hxy
    funext j
    apply Fin.ext
    have hz := congrFun hv j
    dsimp [v] at hz
    exact_mod_cast sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  · intro j
    have hx := (x j).isLt
    have hy := (y j).isLt
    dsimp [v]
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> omega
  · intro i
    have heq := congrArg Fin.val (congrFun hF i)
    change (∑ j, A i j * (x j : ℕ) + (B : ℤ)).toNat =
      (∑ j, A i j * (y j : ℕ) + (B : ℤ)).toNat at heq
    have hx := integer_row_box_bound (A i) (hA i) x
    have hy := integer_row_box_bound (A i) (hA i) y
    rw [abs_le] at hx hy
    have hsum : (∑ j, A i j * (x j : ℕ)) = ∑ j, A i j * (y j : ℕ) := by
      dsimp [B] at *
      omega
    simp only [v, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum, sub_self]

/-- A convenient explicit height bound when there are at least twice as many
unknowns as equations. No nonconstructive choice of an unbounded kernel vector
is needed in the later auxiliary-function construction. -/
theorem exists_bounded_integer_kernel_of_twice_rows_le {m n M : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : 2 * m ≤ n) (A : Fin m → Fin n → ℤ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ (M : ℤ)) :
    ∃ v : Fin n → ℤ, v ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ j, |v j| ≤ (2 * n * M + 1 : ℕ)) ∧
      ∀ i, ∑ j, A i j * v j = 0 := by
  let H := 2 * n * M + 1
  have hH : 1 ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
  have hbox : 2 * (n * M * H) + 1 ≤ H ^ 2 := by dsimp [H]; nlinarith
  have hcount : (2 * (n * M * H) + 1) ^ m < (H + 1) ^ n := by
    calc (2 * (n * M * H) + 1) ^ m ≤ (H ^ 2) ^ m := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbox m
      _ = H ^ (2 * m) := by rw [pow_mul]
      _ ≤ H ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hH hmn
      _ < (H + 1) ^ n := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (Nat.lt_succ_self H) (by omega)
  exact exists_bounded_integer_kernel A hA hcount

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.GreedyLogScale
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.ExponentialBounds

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

theorem logScale_pos_of_gt_two {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) : 0 < logScale n := by
  have hlog : 1 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
    have hnreal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 3 ≤ n by omega)
    have h := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos 1)
      (Real.exp_one_lt_three.trans_le hnreal)
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using h
  exact div_pos (by linarith) (Real.log_pos hlog)

/-- Freeze the finite initial interval at a safe monotonicity threshold. -/
noncomputable def clippedLogScale (N n : ℕ) : ℝ := logScale (max N n)

theorem clippedLogScale_eq {N n : ℕ} (hn : N ≤ n) : clippedLogScale N n = logScale n := by
  rw [clippedLogScale, max_eq_right hn]

theorem clippedLogScale_lower {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (hlogN : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log (N : ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    logScale N ≤ clippedLogScale N n := by
  exact logScaleReal_mono (by exact_mod_cast hN) hlogN (Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_max_left N n))

theorem clippedLogScale_le_real {N n : ℕ} {R : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (hlogN : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log (N : ℝ)) (hNR : (N : ℝ) ≤ R) (hnR : (n : ℝ) ≤ R) :
    clippedLogScale N n ≤ logScaleReal R := by
  have hmaxpos : (0 : ℝ) < (max N n : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < max N n by omega)
  have hmaxlog : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log (max N n : ℕ) :=
    hlogN.trans (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hN) (Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_max_left N n)))
  have hmaxR : ((max N n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ R := by rw [Nat.cast_max]; exact max_le hNR hnR
  exact logScaleReal_mono hmaxpos hmaxlog hmaxR

theorem eventually_clippedLogScale_drop {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (hlogN : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log (N : ℝ)) {C κ : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ r : ℕ, (r : ℝ) ≤ shrinkingRemainder C κ n →
      clippedLogScale N r ≤ logScale n - κ / 4 := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_shrinking_logScale_drop hC hκ,
    (shrinkingRemainder_tendsto_atTop hC κ).eventually_ge_atTop (N : ℝ)] with n hdrop hlarge
  intro r hr
  exact (clippedLogScale_le_real hN hlogN hlarge hr).trans hdrop

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.Arithmetic
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sym
public import Mathlib.Data.Sym.Card
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

theorem SumOfAtMost.mono_terms {S : Set ℕ} {m k n : ℕ}
    (h : SumOfAtMost S m n) (hm : m ≤ k) : SumOfAtMost S k n := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hS, hn⟩ := h
  exact ⟨l, hl.trans hm, hS, hn⟩

theorem SumOfAtMost.mono_set {S T : Set ℕ} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : SumOfAtMost S m n) (hST : S ⊆ T) : SumOfAtMost T m n := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hS, hn⟩ := h
  exact ⟨l, hl, fun x hx => hST (hS x hx), hn⟩

theorem sumOfAtMost_zero (S : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) : SumOfAtMost S m 0 :=
  ⟨[], by simp, by simp, rfl⟩

/-- Sums of at most m entries of a finite alphabet, padded with zero to
exactly m entries so that stars-and-bars applies. -/
def boundedSums (s : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  ((insert 0 s).sym m).image (fun v => v.val.sum)

theorem mem_boundedSums_of_representation {s : Finset ℕ} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : SumOfAtMost (s : Set ℕ) m n) : n ∈ boundedSums s m := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hmem, hsum⟩ := h
  let v : Sym ℕ m := ⟨(l : Multiset ℕ) + Multiset.replicate (m - l.length) 0, by
    simp only [Multiset.card_add, Multiset.coe_card, Multiset.card_replicate]
    omega⟩
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨v, Finset.mem_sym_iff.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    change x ∈ (l : Multiset ℕ) + Multiset.replicate (m - l.length) 0 at hx
    simp only [Multiset.mem_add, Multiset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_replicate] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hmem x hx)
    · simp
  · simp [v, hsum]

theorem card_finset_sym (s : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    (s.sym m).card = (s.card + m - 1).choose m := by
  let e : s ↪ ℕ := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩
  have he : (Finset.univ : Finset s).map e = s := by
    ext x
    simp [e]
  have h := Finset.sym_map e (Finset.univ : Finset s) (n := m)
  rw [he, Finset.sym_univ] at h
  rw [h, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_univ, Sym.card_sym_eq_choose, Fintype.card_coe]

theorem boundedSums_card_le (s : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) (h0 : 0 ∉ s) :
    (boundedSums s m).card ≤ (s.card + m).choose m := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((insert 0 s).sym m).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = _ := by
      rw [card_finset_sym, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem h0]
      congr 1
      omega

/-- Finite pigeonhole step of the covering upper bound, with the sharp
multiset count from the manuscript. -/
theorem exists_missing_of_count {S : Set ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≤ N → x ∈ s) (h0 : 0 ∉ s)
    (hcount : (s.card + m).choose m < N) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ N ∧ ¬ SumOfAtMost S m n := by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hsub : Finset.Icc 1 N ⊆ boundedSums s m := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hn₁, hnN⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hS, hsum⟩ := h n hn₁ hnN
    apply mem_boundedSums_of_representation
    refine ⟨l, hl, ?_, hsum⟩
    intro x hx
    apply hs x (hS x hx)
    have hxle : x ≤ l.sum := List.le_sum_of_mem hx
    omega
  have hc := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (boundedSums_card_le s m h0)
  have hIcc : (Finset.Icc 1 N).card = N := by simp
  omega

/-- A witness is mandatory: no minimum is assigned before existence is proved. -/
def HasMissing (S : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ¬ SumOfAtMost S m n

noncomputable def coveringNumber (S : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) (h : HasMissing S m) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact Nat.find h

theorem coveringNumber_pos {S : Set ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : HasMissing S m) :
    0 < coveringNumber S m h := by
  classical
  exact (Nat.find_spec h).1

theorem coveringNumber_not_representable {S : Set ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : HasMissing S m) :
    ¬ SumOfAtMost S m (coveringNumber S m h) := by
  classical
  exact (Nat.find_spec h).2

theorem coveringNumber_le_of_missing {S : Set ℕ} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : HasMissing S m) (hn : 0 < n) (hnot : ¬ SumOfAtMost S m n) :
    coveringNumber S m h ≤ n := by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_min' h ⟨hn, hnot⟩

theorem representable_below_coveringNumber {S : Set ℕ} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : HasMissing S m) (hn : n < coveringNumber S m h) : SumOfAtMost S m n := by
  classical
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · simpa [hn0] using sumOfAtMost_zero S m
  · by_contra hrep
    exact (Nat.find_min h hn) ⟨by omega, hrep⟩

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.CoveringExistence
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Base

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter
open scoped Topology

/-- The elementary factorial estimate needed for the sharp covering count.
It follows from a single term of the exponential series, without Stirling. -/
theorem log_factorial_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (m : ℝ) * Real.log m - m ≤ Real.log m.factorial := by
  have h := Real.log_le_log (show (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) ^ m / m.factorial by positivity)
    (Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (m : ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg m) m)
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_exp] at h
  linarith

/-- Logarithmic stars-and-bars estimate, retaining the factorial saving that
produces the leading coefficient r−1 rather than r. -/
theorem log_choose_add_le (u : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    Real.log (((u + m).choose m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (m : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (u + m) - Real.log m) := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((u + m).choose m : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos (by omega : m ≤ u + m)
  have h := Real.log_le_log hpos (Nat.choose_le_pow_div m (u + m) (α := ℝ))
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow] at h
  have hfac := log_factorial_lower hm
  push_cast at h
  linarith

/-- Real logarithmic form of the exponent-box bound, valid without
multiplicative independence. -/
theorem truncatedMonoid_card_le_real_log {r : ℕ} {b : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 2 ≤ b i) (N : ℕ) :
    ((truncatedMonoid b N).card : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.log N / Real.log 2 + 1) ^ r := by
  have h := Real.natLog_le_logb N 2
  rw [Real.logb] at h
  have hc : ((truncatedMonoid b N).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Nat.log 2 N : ℝ) + 1) ^ r := by
    exact_mod_cast truncatedMonoid_card_le hb N
  exact hc.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) _)

/-- The manuscript's count T(N) ≤ C₀ (log N)^r, with an explicit constant. -/
theorem truncatedMonoid_card_le_log_power {r : ℕ} {b : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 2 ≤ b i) {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    ((truncatedMonoid b N).card : ℝ) ≤
      (2 / Real.log 2) ^ r * (Real.log N) ^ r := by
  have hlog₂ : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log N :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hN)
  have hratio : 1 ≤ Real.log N / Real.log 2 := (le_div_iff₀ hlog₂).mpr (by simpa)
  calc
    _ ≤ (Real.log N / Real.log 2 + 1) ^ r := truncatedMonoid_card_le_real_log hb N
    _ ≤ (2 * (Real.log N / Real.log 2)) ^ r :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) _
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_right_comm, mul_pow]

/-- The sharp entropy estimate after substituting a polynomial logarithmic
alphabet count. The lower order terms are explicit. -/
theorem log_choose_le_of_polynomial_bound {r u m : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hm : 1 ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log m)
    (hu : (u : ℝ) ≤ C * ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m) ^ r) :
    Real.log (((u + m).choose m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (m : ℝ) * (((r : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log m +
        r * Real.log (Real.log m) + 1 + Real.log (C + 1)) := by
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log (m : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hbase : (m : ℝ) ≤ m * Real.log m := by nlinarith
  have hpow : (m : ℝ) ≤ ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m) ^ r :=
    hbase.trans (le_self_pow₀ (by linarith) (by omega))
  have hub : (u : ℝ) + m ≤ (C + 1) * ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m) ^ r := by
    nlinarith
  have hl := Real.log_le_log (show 0 < (u : ℝ) + m by positivity) hub
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow,
    Real.log_mul hmpos.ne' hlogpos.ne'] at hl
  have hmnat : 0 < m := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
  refine (log_choose_add_le u hmnat).trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hmpos.le
  nlinarith

/-- The explicit lower order terms in the entropy estimate vanish after
normalization by log m. -/
theorem tendsto_covering_count_error (r : ℕ) (C : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ =>
      ((r : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log m) + 1 + Real.log (C + 1)) / Real.log m)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have htlog := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hratio := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp htlog
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (1 + Real.log (C + 1)) / Real.log m)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop htlog
  simpa only [mul_zero, zero_add] using
    ((hratio.const_mul (r : ℝ)).add hconst).congr
      (fun m => by dsimp; ring)

/-- The leading coefficient of the multiset logarithm is r−1. This theorem
separates the entropy estimate from the choice of the truncation threshold. -/
theorem eventually_log_choose_lt {r : ℕ} {C η : ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hu : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, (u m : ℝ) ≤ C * ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m) ^ r) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, Real.log ((((u m + m).choose m) : ℕ) : ℝ) <
      ((r : ℝ) - 1 + η) * m * Real.log m := by
  have herror := (tendsto_order.mp (tendsto_covering_count_error r C)).2 η hη
  have hlog := (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hu, herror, hlog, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with m hum hem hlm hm
  change 1 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) at hlm
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have hlpos : 0 < Real.log (m : ℝ) := by linarith
  have he := (div_lt_iff₀ hlpos).mp hem
  have hb := log_choose_le_of_polynomial_bound hr hC hmR hlm hum
  refine hb.trans_lt ?_
  have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left he hmpos
  nlinarith

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.MultiBase
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter
open scoped Topology

/-- Every fixed polynomial is eventually smaller than a geometric sequence,
including the shift needed for the exponent-box count. -/
theorem eventually_polynomial_lt_two_pow (C d : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, C * (k + 1) ^ d < 2 ^ k := by
  have ht := (tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt d
    (r := (2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (C : ℝ) * 2 *
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ d / (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using ht.const_mul ((C : ℝ) * 2)
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp ht').2 1 (by norm_num)] with k hk
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
  rw [pow_succ] at hk
  have h : (C : ℝ) * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ d < (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k * 2 by positivity)).mp
      (show (C : ℝ) * 2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ d / (2 ^ k * 2) < 1 by
        simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hk)
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast h

/-- Every finitely generated power monoid with bases at least two has a
positive integer requiring more than any prescribed number of summands. -/
theorem hasMissing_powerMonoid {r : ℕ} {b : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 2 ≤ b i) (m : ℕ) : HasMissing (powerMonoid b) m := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (eventually_polynomial_lt_two_pow ((m + 1) ^ m) (r * m)).exists
  have hlog : Nat.log 2 (2 ^ k) = k := Nat.log_pow (by norm_num) _
  have hcard := truncatedMonoid_card_le hb (2 ^ k)
  rw [hlog] at hcard
  have hone : 1 ≤ (k + 1) ^ r := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hbase : (truncatedMonoid b (2 ^ k)).card + m ≤ (m + 1) * (k + 1) ^ r := by
    nlinarith
  have hcount : ((truncatedMonoid b (2 ^ k)).card + m).choose m < 2 ^ k := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ((truncatedMonoid b (2 ^ k)).card + m) ^ m := Nat.choose_le_pow _ _
      _ ≤ ((m + 1) * (k + 1) ^ r) ^ m := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbase _
      _ = (m + 1) ^ m * (k + 1) ^ (r * m) := by rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      _ < _ := hk
  obtain ⟨n, hn, _, hnot⟩ := exists_missing_powerMonoid_of_count hb hcount
  exact ⟨n, by omega, hnot⟩

theorem powerMonoid_two_ten : powerMonoid ![2, 10] = golayMonoid₂ := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e 0, e 1, by simp [powerProduct, Fin.prod_univ_succ]⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![a, b], by simp [powerProduct, Fin.prod_univ_succ]⟩

theorem powerMonoid_two_ten_twentySix : powerMonoid ![2, 10, 26] = golayMonoid₃ := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e 0, e 1, e 2, by simp [powerProduct, Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨![a, b, c], by simp [powerProduct, Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]⟩

theorem hasMissing_golayMonoid₂ (m : ℕ) : HasMissing golayMonoid₂ m := by
  rw [← powerMonoid_two_ten]
  exact hasMissing_powerMonoid (by decide) m

theorem hasMissing_golayMonoid₃ (m : ℕ) : HasMissing golayMonoid₃ m := by
  rw [← powerMonoid_two_ten_twentySix]
  exact hasMissing_powerMonoid (by decide) m

/-- Livinskyi's covering function for the Golay monoid is well defined at every m. -/
noncomputable def golayCoveringNumber₃ (m : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  coveringNumber golayMonoid₃ m (hasMissing_golayMonoid₃ m)

theorem golayCoveringNumber₃_pos (m : ℕ) : 0 < golayCoveringNumber₃ m :=
  coveringNumber_pos _

theorem golayCoveringNumber₃_not_representable (m : ℕ) :
    ¬ SumOfAtMost golayMonoid₃ m (golayCoveringNumber₃ m) :=
  coveringNumber_not_representable _

end HadamardMultibase

public import HadamardMultibase.CoveringLower

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter

theorem DistinctSum.sumOfAtMost {S : Set ℕ} {n : ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ}
    (hs : DistinctSum S n s) : SumOfAtMost S s.card n := by
  classical
  exact ⟨s.toList, by simp, by simpa using hs.1, by simpa using hs.2⟩

/-- The general covering lower bound reduced to polynomial separation for
one pair of generators. Representation and positivity remain explicit. -/
theorem coveringNumber_lower_of_separation {S : Set ℕ} {p q : ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ S, 0 < a)
    (hrep : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ s : Finset ℕ, DistinctSum S n s)
    (hmissing : ∀ m, HasMissing S m)
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hmem : ∀ l m : ℕ, p ^ l * q ^ m ∈ S)
    (hsep : PolynomialRotationSeparation (Real.log (q : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ))) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp (c * m * Real.log m) ≤ (coveringNumber S m (hmissing m) : ℝ) := by
  have h1 : 1 ∈ S := by simpa using hmem 0 0
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := sparse_bound_of_separation hpos hrep hp hq hmem hsep
  apply coveringNumber_lower_of_representation h1 hmissing hK
  refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcard⟩ := hbound n (by omega)
  exact ⟨s.card, hs.sumOfAtMost, hcard⟩

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.Asymptotics
public import HadamardMultibase.CoveringUpper

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter
open scoped Topology

/-- A useful quantitative inverse to the logarithmic scale. The explicit
threshold avoids any monotonicity assertion near its singularity. -/
theorem logScaleReal_exp_mul_log_le {c x : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log x) (hclog : -2 * Real.log c ≤ Real.log x) :
    logScaleReal (Real.exp (c * x * Real.log x)) ≤ 2 * c * x := by
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log x := by linarith
  have hloglog : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := Real.log_nonneg hlog
  have hden : Real.log x / 2 ≤ Real.log (c * x * Real.log x) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos hc hx).ne' hlogpos.ne', Real.log_mul hc.ne' hx.ne']
    linarith
  have hdenpos : 0 < Real.log (c * x * Real.log x) := by linarith
  unfold logScaleReal
  rw [Real.log_exp, div_le_iff₀ hdenpos]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hden (show 0 ≤ 2 * c * x by positivity)]

theorem sumOfAtMost_of_one_mem {S : Set ℕ} (h1 : 1 ∈ S) {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) :
    SumOfAtMost S m n := by
  refine ⟨List.replicate n 1, by simpa, ?_, by simp⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx1 : x = 1 := (List.mem_replicate.mp hx).2
  simpa [hx1] using h1

theorem SparseDecomposition.sumOfAtMost {n : ℕ} {s : Finset ℕ}
    (hs : SparseDecomposition n s) : SumOfAtMost golayMonoid₂ s.card n := by
  classical
  exact ⟨s.toList, by simp, by simpa using hs.1, by simpa using hs.2⟩

/-- Inversion of any eventual logarithmic representation estimate. The finite
initial interval is represented by ones, rather than using false global
monotonicity of log/loglog. -/
theorem coveringNumber_lower_of_representation {S : Set ℕ} (h1 : 1 ∈ S)
    (hmissing : ∀ m, HasMissing S m) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hrep : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
      ∃ k : ℕ, SumOfAtMost S k n ∧ (k : ℝ) ≤ K * logScale n) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp (c * m * Real.log m) ≤ (coveringNumber S m (hmissing m) : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := hrep
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp eventually_logScale_threshold
  let N := max N₀ N₁
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (4 * K)
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have hlog := (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop
    (max 1 (-2 * Real.log c))
  filter_upwards [hlog, eventually_ge_atTop (max N 1)] with m hlm hm
  change max 1 (-2 * Real.log c) ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) at hlm
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m by omega)
  have hlogm : 1 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hlm
  have hclog : -2 * Real.log c ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hlm
  have hscale := logScaleReal_exp_mul_log_le hc hmpos hlogm hclog
  by_contra h
  have hnlt : (coveringNumber S m (hmissing m) : ℝ) < Real.exp (c * m * Real.log m) :=
    lt_of_not_ge h
  let n := coveringNumber S m (hmissing m)
  have hnnot : ¬ SumOfAtMost S m n := coveringNumber_not_representable _
  apply hnnot
  by_cases hnN : n < N
  · exact sumOfAtMost_of_one_mem h1 (by omega)
  · have hnN' : N ≤ n := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkbound⟩ := hN₀ n ((le_max_left _ _).trans hnN')
    have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast coveringNumber_pos (hmissing m)
    have hnlog := hN₁ n ((le_max_right _ _).trans hnN')
    have hmono : logScale n ≤ logScaleReal (Real.exp (c * m * Real.log m)) :=
      logScaleReal_mono hnpos hnlog hnlt.le
    have hkm : (k : ℝ) ≤ m := by
      have hkb := hkbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono.trans hscale) hK.le)
      have heq : K * (2 * c * m) = (m : ℝ) / 2 := by dsimp [c]; field_simp; ring
      rw [heq] at hkb
      linarith
    exact hk.mono_terms (by exact_mod_cast hkm)

theorem golayCoveringNumber₃_lower (hS : SparseRepresentationBound) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp (c * m * Real.log m) ≤ (golayCoveringNumber₃ m : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := hS
  apply coveringNumber_lower_of_representation (S := golayMonoid₃)
    (by exact ⟨0, 0, 0, by simp⟩) hasMissing_golayMonoid₃ hK
  refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcard⟩ := hbound n (by omega)
  exact ⟨s.card, hs.sumOfAtMost.mono_set golayMonoid₂_subset, hcard⟩

end HadamardMultibase

module

public import HadamardMultibase.CoveringEstimates

@[expose] public section

namespace HadamardMultibase

open Filter
open scoped Topology

/-- Rounding an exponential upward costs at most log 2 in its logarithm. -/
theorem log_ceil_exp_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    x ≤ Real.log (⌈Real.exp x⌉₊ : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (⌈Real.exp x⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ x + Real.log 2 := by
  have he : 1 ≤ Real.exp x := Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr hx
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp x)
  have hround := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.exp_pos x).le
  constructor
  · simpa using Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos x) hc
  · have hle : (⌈Real.exp x⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp x := by linarith
    have h := Real.log_le_log ((Real.exp_pos x).trans_le hc) hle
    simpa [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (Real.exp_ne_zero x),
      Real.log_exp, add_comm] using h

/-- Sharp covering upper bound for any finite set of bases at least two.
Independence is unnecessary for this half of the covering theorem. -/
theorem coveringNumber_upper_ceil {r : ℕ} {b : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 2 ≤ b i) (hr : 2 ≤ r) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      coveringNumber (powerMonoid b) m (hasMissing_powerMonoid hb m) ≤
        ⌈Real.exp (((r : ℝ) - 1 + η) * m * Real.log m)⌉₊ := by
  classical
  let A : ℝ := (r : ℝ) - 1 + η
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A]
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
    linarith
  let N : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => ⌈Real.exp (A * m * Real.log m)⌉₊
  let C : ℝ := (2 / Real.log 2) ^ r * (A + 1) ^ r
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hlog := (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  have hcount : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      ((truncatedMonoid b (N m)).card : ℝ) ≤ C * ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m) ^ r := by
    filter_upwards [hlog, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with m hlm hm
    change 1 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) at hlm
    have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    have hx : 0 ≤ A * m * Real.log m := by positivity
    have hbounds := log_ceil_exp_bounds hx
    have hlog₂ : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith
    have hnlog : Real.log (N m) ≤ (A + 1) * ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m) := by
      change Real.log (⌈Real.exp (A * m * Real.log m)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ _
      nlinarith [hbounds.2]
    have hn : 2 ≤ N m := by
      have hexp : 1 < Real.exp (A * m * Real.log m) :=
        Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity)
      have hc := Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp (A * m * Real.log m))
      have : (1 : ℝ) < N m := hexp.trans_le hc
      exact_mod_cast this
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 / Real.log 2) ^ r * (Real.log (N m)) ^ r :=
        truncatedMonoid_card_le_log_power hb hn
      _ ≤ (2 / Real.log 2) ^ r * ((A + 1) * ((m : ℝ) * Real.log m)) ^ r := by
        gcongr
      _ = _ := by dsimp [C]; rw [mul_pow]; ring
  have hentropy := eventually_log_choose_lt (u := fun m => (truncatedMonoid b (N m)).card)
    (by omega : 0 < r) hC (half_pos hη) hcount
  filter_upwards [hentropy, hlog, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with m hent hlm hm
  change 1 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) at hlm
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m by omega)
  have hlpos : 0 < Real.log (m : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hbounds := log_ceil_exp_bounds (show 0 ≤ A * m * Real.log m by positivity)
  have hlt : Real.log ((((truncatedMonoid b (N m)).card + m).choose m : ℕ) : ℝ) <
      Real.log (N m) := by
    apply hent.trans
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ hbounds.1
    dsimp [A]
    nlinarith [mul_pos hmpos hlpos]
  have hchoosepos : (0 : ℝ) <
      (((truncatedMonoid b (N m)).card + m).choose m : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos (by omega : m ≤ (truncatedMonoid b (N m)).card + m)
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < N m :=
    (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le (Nat.le_ceil _)
  have hnat : ((truncatedMonoid b (N m)).card + m).choose m < N m := by
    exact_mod_cast (Real.log_lt_log_iff hchoosepos hnpos).mp hlt
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hnN, hnot⟩ := exists_missing_powerMonoid_of_count hb hnat
  exact (coveringNumber_le_of_missing _ (by omega) hnot).trans hnN

/-- The upper half of the manuscript's covering theorem, with the o(1)
expressed as an arbitrary positive η. -/
theorem coveringNumber_upper {r : ℕ} {b : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 2 ≤ b i) (hr : 2 ≤ r) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      (coveringNumber (powerMonoid b) m (hasMissing_powerMonoid hb m) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (((r : ℝ) - 1 + η) * m * Real.log m) := by
  have hc := coveringNumber_upper_ceil hb hr (half_pos hη)
  have hl := (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop
    (max 1 (2 * Real.log 2 / η))
  filter_upwards [hc, hl, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with m hcm hlm hm
  change max 1 (2 * Real.log 2 / η) ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) at hlm
  have hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hlm
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hrR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hA : 0 < (r : ℝ) - 1 + η / 2 := by linarith
  have hx : 0 ≤ ((r : ℝ) - 1 + η / 2) * m * Real.log m := by positivity
  have hround := (log_ceil_exp_bounds hx).2
  have he := (div_le_iff₀ hη).mp ((le_max_right _ _).trans hlm)
  have hlogbound : Real.log
      (⌈Real.exp (((r : ℝ) - 1 + η / 2) * m * Real.log m)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤
        ((r : ℝ) - 1 + η) * m * Real.log m := by
    have hmul : Real.log (m : ℝ) ≤ m * Real.log m := by nlinarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul hη.le
    nlinarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) <
      ⌈Real.exp (((r : ℝ) - 1 + η / 2) * m * Real.log m)⌉₊ :=
    (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le (Nat.le_ceil _)
  have hfinal := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogbound
  rw [Real.exp_log hpos] at hfinal
  exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcm).trans hfinal

theorem golayCoveringNumber₃_upper {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, (golayCoveringNumber₃ m : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp ((2 + η) * m * Real.log m) := by
  have h := coveringNumber_upper (b := ![2, 10, 26]) (by decide) (by decide) hη
  simpa [powerMonoid_two_ten_twentySix, golayCoveringNumber₃,
    show (3 : ℝ) - 1 = 2 by norm_num] using h

end HadamardMultibase
